Fisher Investments is an independent, fee-only investment adviser serving clients across three principal business units: US Private Client, Institutional and Private Client International. Together, these groups serve a diverse global client base that includes corporations, public and multi-employer pension funds, foundations and endowments, governments and high net worth families. 
 
Fisher Investments was founded in 1979 by Ken Fisher, who served as CEO for 37 years and now serves as Executive Chairman and Co-Chief Investment Officer. Ken wrote the Forbes “Portfolio Strategy” column from 1984 through 2016, making him the longest continuously running columnist in the magazine’s history. He now writes monthly native language columns in major media organs around the world, spanning more countries and more total volume than any other columnist of any type ever. Ken has written 11 books—including 4 New York Times bestsellers—and has regularly appeared on CNBC, Fox Business, Fox News, CNN International, Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg TV, and numerous other financial news outlets.
 
For more information on Fisher Investments, please visit www.fisherinvestments.com.

LV= is a protection, investment and retirement specialist and one of the UK’s leading life and pensions mutual insurers.

Our 1,300 people help our members and customers protect their income while they are working and maximise it when they stop. By doing this we enable people to live financially confident lives.

We offer a range of products, services and advice and serve over a million members and customers. They hold a variety of products with us including life insurance, income protection, investments and retirement income solutions such as equity release, fixed term annuities and drawdown products. We want members to be able to plan for a financially secure future. We put our members at the heart of all that we do.

We believe that everyone should have access to independent, regulated financial advice. It shouldn't be seen as a luxury for the few who can afford it or who are experienced in using it. Why? Because it provides financial and emotional benefits. Good advice ensures better financial outcomes and frees people from the worry of making complex decisions that could have long-term implications.

We work with a wide range of financial advisers and it is through them that the majority of customers will buy our products and services.

We also licence our brand to LV= General Insurance Group (LV= GI), a subsidiary of Allianz Holdings plc. LV= General Insurance is one of the largest personal insurers in the UK and looks after the car, home, landlord, pet and travel insurance needs of over 4.5 million customers.

Wesleyan Assurance Society has been helping people secure their financial futures for over 180 years. 

Over the years we’ve stood strong in an ever changing and often challenging world. We have survived two world wars, global depressions and more recently the financial crisis of 2008 that saw the collapse or bailout of some of the biggest names in financial services.

Our mutual status is as important to us today as it has ever been. As a mutual, we don’t have shareholders so we can work to benefit those who invest in our business – our customers and members.

We have remained financially strong over the years and this has allowed us to take a long-term view. We don’t react to short-term events but stay focused on supporting the financial futures of some of society's most trusted professions - specifically doctors, dentists and teachers.

We're extremely proud of our 180-year history and believe that our continued success is driven by our vibrant, inclusive and diverse workforce.

We encourage and empower our people, helping them make a difference in whichever role they fill. Our new Smart Working approach also enables our employees to be the best they can be, wherever they may be.

All of these things combined enable us to truly say, “we are all about you”.

Stonehage Fleming is adviser to many of the world’s leading families and wealth creators. 

We help families manage and protect their wealth now and for future generations. 
To meet their needs we are able to draw on a rich array of in-house experience and expertise to manage and protect their wealth; we also work closely with families’ existing offices, advisers and our extensive network of professional firms.

Our relationships with clients would typically include:
 - Helping define the purpose of the family wealth, its governance and succession plans.
 - Managing and administering international structures such as trusts and companies.
 - Managing investment portfolios on a discretionary and advisory basis.
 - Ensuring plans are in place for all phases of the financial life cycle and that wealth is structured efficiently
 - Identification and mitigation of the full spectrum of risks to family wealth.
 - Reviewing legal structures, taking account of cross-border and inter-generational considerations.
 - Sourcing and advising on private capital investment opportunities.
 - Creating reports aggregating and analysing all aspects of client wealth.
 - Coordination and execution of all banking and treasury needs.
 - Advising on matters of corporate finance for the family business and other commercial interests.
 - Management of art collections and other lifestyle assets.

We have a rich array of in-house expertise but we also work closely with families’ existing advisers and our network of experienced professional partners, in particular lawyers, accountants and trustees. Our scale and market presence enable us to identify the best professional partners internationally. We deliver the optimal combination of internal and external advice based on client needs.

Keep up to date with our latest news and insights here: https://www.stonehagefleming.com/insights

Since 2008, we have been committed to offering clients a fresh approach to wealth management, with a service that is as individual as they are. By drawing together in-depth knowledge and experience from across the industry, we provide a flexible, bespoke service adapted to each of our clients’ needs.

Our rigorous investment process means that we do not invest in anything we do not believe in. We do not manufacture and sell in-house products and we do not have product sales targets. Our advice is aligned to nobody’s interests but those of our clients.

column1: KRESTON REEVES FINANCIAL PLANNING SERVICES LIMITED
column10:
We guide our clients, colleagues and communities to a brighter future.  

We help businesses, not for profit organisations, individuals and families with more than just accountancy, business and wealth advice.  

In a continually evolving world we help all generations embrace change through trusted advice, support and guidance. Our dedication to providing a personal service is what sets us apart – we get to know you, understand your goals, support and advise you on your journey to help you realise your ambitions. 

We’re proud to be B Corp certified, demonstrating our commitment to our environmental, social and governance programme which is central to our purpose and vision as a firm.  

We have offices across London, Kent and Sussex, as well as global reach through our membership of Kreston Global, an international advisory and accountancy network across 115 countries.  

Our dedication to meeting the needs of our clients – wherever they are based and whatever their structure and size – is what sets us apart. So whether your business is well established or a start-up, an international company or an owner managed business – we can help. If you are a charity or not for profit organisation or an individual looking for private tax and wealth advice, we can help with your needs too.

We also pride ourselves on being a socially responsible employer and actively encourage all our colleagues to give back to their local communities whenever they can.

We provide a full range of accountancy, business advisory and financial services, tailored to our clients’ needs. We also have well established teams of specialists across our offices who have a particular sector focus. 

To learn more about us, our services and how we can help you, visit our website or contact us today.

column1: Chase de Vere Independent Financial Advisers limited
column10:
At Chase de Vere, we believe the only worthwhile advice is independent advice. This is because it allows us to research the variety of sources, and recommend the solutions and products that best suit your needs – creating a far stronger result.

The freedom to advise objectively

• We are free to create financial plans that are totally unconstrained by any obligation – other than to our clients

• From investment management and estate planning, to employee benefits and business advice, we offer solutions that are drawn from the whole market

• We give each solution careful consideration and only then recommend one that is right for you and your situation

• We are a team, but we think and act independently. This helps us give a more considered, creative and
sometimes non-obvious solution.

About us

• We are one of the country’s leading independent financial advisers

• We offer wide national coverage with regional offices and over 200 independent financial advisers and about 250 technical and back-office specialists

• Our advisers are encouraged to attain the highest levels of industry qualification and pursue advisory specialisms.

Armstrong Watson has been advising and protecting clients across the North of England and Scotland since 1867. With 19 regional offices from Glasgow to Leeds, and over 800 colleagues, we’re focused enough to provide a truly tailored service and large and experienced enough to work alongside any size of business, delivering a complete remit of services equal to top tier firms.

Our full range of specialist services and financial advice includes accountancy, tax, payroll, corporate finance, financial planning, wealth management, forensic accounting, outsourced finance functions, and corporate restructuring, recovery and insolvency. As a member of the MSI Global Alliance, we’re also able to provide worldwide professional services through our international partner firms.

We pride ourselves in knowing our client’s businesses inside and out, understanding every part of the operation, people, processes, current status and forecasted plans. We will share in your vision, work with you as you progress towards identified goals and support and guide you, helping you to find key areas of opportunity, efficiency and growth.

Our core purpose is to support, advise and protect companies and individuals for the long term, enabling you to achieve prosperity, a secure future and peace of mind.

We are one of the UK’s leading national firms of independent financial advisers, committed to providing a personal and professional service to both individual and corporate clients.

Established in 2004, Ascot Lloyd is a company that has grown rapidly through bringing smaller IFA firms into the fold to become a stronger and larger firm. 

Through our commitment to strong governance, robust infrastructure, cutting-edge technology, and exceptional support, we deliver an excellent and reliable service to our continuously expanding client base. Currently, we serve 22,000 core clients in a highly regulated industry, and we are proud to provide them with the utmost level of quality and security in everything we do.

THE ASCOT LLOYD DIFFERENCE

We pride ourselves on Being an independent Financial advisory firm which means we are not tied into certain partnerships or product solutions; therefore, we can search the whole market to find the most appropriate solutions to help you reach your financial goals

Client satisfaction is at the heart of what we do: We believe we have a refreshingly different approach to working with our clients and central to everything we do is client satisfaction.

Highly qualified: Whilst we have a strong technical pedigree with a clear focus on continued professional development for all our staff, we’re pragmatic and practical in our solutions.

Practical, jargon free advice: We ensure we provide our clients with jargon-free advice and establish realistic financial plans.

Open and honest:  We ensure our clients are completely clear about what we can or cannot deliver and we clearly explain the benefits, implications and considerations of everything we recommend.

Continued development: We encourage and welcome feedback from our clients to ensure we continue to deliver the highest levels of customer service. We listen to the needs of our customers and use any feedback to inform the future decisions of our business.

From the financial sector to the energy sector, iQ Group is committed to providing technological solutions to lead Iraq into prosperity and the new digital age.

column10:
2plan wealth management is the UK's largest independent advisory firm.

Our proposition is designed to provide client-led professional financial advice, backed up by the highest quality service and support.

We advise on products across the whole marketplace and we act solely in the best interests of our clients at all times. We do not act on behalf of any product provider, bank or insurance company. 

Our focus is to bring together the best of breed in advisers and firms to provide financial planning and wealth management for private investors and businesses across the UK. Our strategy is built on giving our advisers structured technology-based processes, creating maximum cost efficiency and minimal administrative burden. Using a bespoke, modular advice process, we provide a robust and compliant business model offering the highest commitment to client service standards. 

We proudly boast a great culture at 2plan with advisers scoring us highly on the services and support we provide, enabling them to spend more time with their clients and leave the administration, regulation and technology to us. 

Alongside that, we have always invested strongly in technology. Our advisers and their clients tell us that our Client Access Portal is second-to-none in the way advice and service can happen remotely in a secure and compliant way. It’s a tool that has really come into its own this last year. 

What’s more, we have our own IT company, which is a brilliant addition to our proposition. 

Our philosophy is always to ensure that the client experience is paramount, and our all advisers pride themselves on building trusted and lasting long-term relationships. 

2plan wealth management provides the tools and expertise, support and services so every financial adviser and firm can conduct business in a safe environment, whilst also giving specialist advice and help throughout the advice process, according to the individual needs of every client.

Brookson was born with a clear purpose – there must be a better way. 

For over 20 years we have helped our clients deal with the complexities, uncertainties and compliance challenges that the changing world of work creates. Whether that is helping individuals who want to work flexibly, assisting organisations wanting more access to this flexible workforce, or supporting entrepreneurs looking to start or grow their business. 

The Brookson world is a dynamic one – we move quickly and innovatively to support our customers’ changing needs. We use our knowledge and capabilities to develop services that are easy to understand, easy to access and easy to use. We make the complex simple and straightforward. 

We have succeeded by constantly developing market shaping, technology-based professional services which reduce effort and hassle for each of our customer segments: providing the best advisory, compliance and administrative services they need and leaving them free to focus on the things that are most important to them. Today our founding purpose holds true but our ambition is greater than ever: our mission is to revolutionise professional services for the changing world of work. We will achieve this by continuing to develop innovative services and genuinely caring about our customers, whilst always seeking better ways to help them succeed.

Our mission is to always put our client’s goals at the centre of everything we do. We know that financial success is best achieved through precise and sustained focus, which is why our teams work very closely to create the best possible outcome. Established in 1940, Bartlett Group is an independent insurance and financial solutions specialist, offering tailored services for businesses and individuals. From bespoke insurance solutions to employee benefit packages, wealth management, and independent financial advice, our comprehensive offerings reflect our commitment to excellence. Honoured with accolades such as the UK Broker of the Year and Commercial Lines Broker of the Year in 2020, and ranked in the Financial Times Top 100 UK Financial Advisers, Bartlett Group operates globally, reaching clients in over 30 countries through our UK and overseas offices and an extensive network of associates. As a Chartered Insurance Broker, our dedication to quality is evident in our client-centric approach and the expertise of our in-house team. 
 
Today, managed proudly by the third generation of Bartletts, Bartlett Group serves businesses, charities, and individuals across the UK, ranging from regional manufacturing firms to large financial institutions. Private clients include families we've had the privilege of assisting for generations. Looking forward to the next decade rather than the next quarter, we are well-positioned to continue creating meaningful and enjoyable careers for our colleagues nationwide. When you join Bartlett, you contribute to supporting vulnerable young people in the UK and abroad. We allocate 8% of our profits to grassroots organisations, raising over a million pounds in the last four years alone for remarkable causes.

Navigating markets effectively and securing success, we invite you to discover more about Bartlett's standard-setting services at www.bartlettgroup.com.

column10:
As one of the largest privately owned Independent Financial Advisers in the UK, we have been building successful long-term relationships with clients for 50 years. 

The keystone upon which Lowes clients have prospered is our personal approach to financial planning, enabling us to help with their goals to build and ultimately protect their wealth.

Lowes has almost 1bn assets under management and 95% of clients rate our investment advice as 'Good' or 'Very Good'. Over 80 people work for the firm in some capacity. As well as providing investment management, Lowes can advise on Inheritance Tax planning, pensions, long term care and other general financial planning issues. A combined wealth of experience and industry knowledge ensures clients receive financial advice that is tailored to their personal needs and expectations.

Lowes provides a bespoke and model investment portfolio service and we pride ourselves on being an 'Independent' Financial Adviser. This means we look across the whole investment space into alternatives, alongside traditional investments, to deliver attractive returns for clients, taking the appropriate level of risk. The investment process is not driven by external set asset allocation, but by the investment team's own fund selection and asset parameters. Our long history in investments means that we have experienced different economic styles and recognise the importance of protecting client's money.

We are also a renowned expert in the field of structured products and run CompareStructuredProducts.com. 

Our expertise in the field of financial planning has led to being acknowledged in industry awards over the years, something which we are justly proud of.

Lowes Financial Management is Authorised and Regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Fidelius is a leading financial services company, committed to excellent customer service. We provide a range of solutions for individuals and companies, including wealth management and employee benefits. We work with clients across the UK and have offices in Bath, Cheltenham, Chelmsford, London, and Mansfield. 

Fidelius Wealth Management provides a wide range of wealth management and financial planning services to private clients.   All of our services have been developed in direct response to our clients’ needs. We are totally committed to always providing exceptional levels of customer service and tailored, effective wealth management advice.

All of our financial planners are highly qualified and we use market-leading software to streamline processes and keep administration for our clients to an absolute minimum. Our ongoing technical research ensures we keep our clients up-to-date with any relevant changes in the market or legislation.

Fidelius Employee Benefits help businesses of all shapes and sizes from a wide variety of industry sectors.  Although we can help very small and very large businesses, our ‘tailor and support’ approach is ideally suited to employers with 50 – 5,000 staff. We provide a wide range of company pension, employee benefits and investment consulting services.

Our mortgage team have the know-how and experience to offer mortgage services for first-time buyers, house moves and remortgages, returning expats and foreign nationals.

At Eight Wealth Management Ltd, a Principal Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management, we have a wide range of expertise and knowledge, developed over many years, to help people - both individually and in business - fulfil their aims and aspirations, as well as offering that all important 'peace of mind' for the future.

Putting our clients firmly at the heart of everything we do enables us to run a genuinely client-focused business. In our experience, no two clients are the same and we therefore ensure that we understand your personal or business objectives and deliver solutions that are right for you. 

  We aim to deliver our commitment by:
- Providing personal face to face financial advice
- Giving you the opportunity to review your financial affairs regularly
- Effectively managing your investments via our distinctive approach
- Keeping you informed of the latest news 
- Listening to your feedback
- Offering you seminars and events 

We do not provide off the shelf solutions, but we offer the benefit of a single relationship for all of your financial planning needs. We strive to offer the very best service to develop great relationships.

The value of an investment with St. James's Place will be directly linked to the performance of the funds you select and the value can therefore go down as well as up. You may get back less than you invested. 

Eight Wealth Management Ltd is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James’s Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority) for the purpose of advising solely on the Group’s wealth management products and services, more details of which are set out on the Group’s website at www.sjp.co.uk/products. The `St. James’s Place Partnership’ and the titles `Partner’ and `Partner Practice’ are marketing terms used to describe St. James’s Place representatives.

Spire Solicitors LLP was established in October 2013, following the merger of three of Norfolk's most established law firms - Greenland Houchen Pomeroy Solicitors (GHP), Hood Vores & Allwood Solicitors (HVA) and Overbury Steward Eaton & Woolsey Solicitors (Overburys). 

As a result, Spire Solicitors is now one of the largest legal firms in the region. With head offices in the heart of Norwich city centre, we also boost an unrivalled regional presence across the county, with offices in market towns throughout Norfolk including Aylsham, Attleborough, Dereham, Diss, Watton and Wymondham. 

We offer a comprehensive range of legal advice and our dedicated team of qualified partners, solicitors, legal executives and paralegals work hand-in-hand with our clients to deliver a friendly and personal service that is tailored to meet the needs of our clients across the county.

We are here to bring focus back to what truly matters, and redefine the meaning of wealth. 

Traditionally, society has measured wealth purely in terms of accumulation, money in the bank and assets in the portfolio – without stopping to ask why.

The world has changed. Many people are reflecting on their lives and realising that their true wealth lies not in their financial assets, but in their family, lifestyle, and legacy. Our purpose is to help people redefine wealth on their own terms. We are a team of expert financial advisers passionate about helping people achieve their lifelong ambitions and offer a path to long term freedom and peace of mind.

What if you could achieve a life of freedom and fulfilment, and leave a lasting legacy created on your terms?

Starting from the simple principle that every client should be treated as our only client, our foundations are based on trust, experience and outstanding service. We deliver financial advice from our three distinct brands.

Cooper Associates Mortgages is an award-winning mortgage advisory firm, delivering mortgage and protection advice. We do not believe in off-the-shelf solutions and understand every single client has their own unique personal concerns, responsibilities and ambitions. Whatever you are looking to do, our bespoke fee free mortgage advice will be tailored perfectly to suit your individual requirements.

Cooper Associates Accountants is an accountancy firm and offers services to individuals, sole traders, partnerships and limited companies. Our aim is to deliver value-adding advice underpinned with a bespoke, diligent and personal service. 

Cooper Associates Wealth Management is a financial advisory firm, delivering investment, retirement planning and inheritance tax advice. We recognise for financial advice to be truly valuable it must be based on an appreciation of your individual circumstances. Our objective is to help you achieve your financial goals and we do this by adopting a truly holistic approach. 

Cooper Associates Wealth Management Ltd is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James’s Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority). SJP Approved 16/12/2024

The services provided by Cooper Associates Mortgages and Cooper Associates Accountants are separate and distinct from those offered by Cooper Associates Wealth Management and St. James’s Place

We are an award-winning National Independent Financial Advice firm that offers a modern financial advice service.

In 2020 we were awarded the ESG kitemark in recognition of our business approach to Environmental, Social Responsibility and Governance matters.

We have over 16,000 clients and hold assets under influence in excess of £2.3 billion.

Insight Financial Associates is one of East Anglia’s premier firms offering independent financial advice to clients all over the country. 
With the head office in Norwich, Norfolk, Insight also has offices in Harlow, Sevenoaks, St Ives, Bridgend, Spain. 

With 21 Independent Financial Advisers focused on enabling clients to achieve and maintain their desired standard of living, Insight offers levels of service based on clients’ needs and financial goals.

Insight Financial Associates is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Working closely with Insight Private Finance Ltd (provides residential & Buy to Let mortgages and protection), Foresight Estate Planning & Will Writing (legacy planning, trusts and will writing) and Property Investment Partnership (below-market properties to grow wealth and generate income), Insight is able to offer clients an integrated and holistic financial service.

For more information call 01603 268080 or visit www.insightifa.com

Flying Colours – for a brighter financial future

We are an independent, UK-wide financial advice firm. Our passion is helping you to achieve your financial goals. We especially enjoy helping those who are:
•	Planning for retirement – whether it’s 20 years away or starting tomorrow, we can help you to achieve the retirement you want.
•	In retirement – now that you’re reaping the rewards of all those years of working, we can assist you in managing your finances so that you can make the most of your retirement.
•	In later life – we can provide guidance to ensure that your finances will provide the care you need, whilst passing on a legacy to those you care about most.
•	Business owners – whether you’re looking to protect your business from the loss of a key person, or simply looking at ways to maximise your income, we can help.

Our expert independent financial advisers can help you: 
•	Grow your wealth 
•	Manage your finances tax efficiently 
•	Protect yourself and your family from financial shocks 
•	Plan your retirement 
•	Prepare for your financial needs in later life
•	Pass on your wealth 

Book a free, no obligation consultation at: www.fcadvice.co.uk

We have a transparent and fresh approach to independent financial advice with a strong company culture. If you would like to join our team, please get in touch we would love to hear from professional likeminded individuals with experiences in; administration, paraplanning and financial advice.  

If you think you would make a good addition to our community get in contact with us at careers@fcadvice.co.uk

column10:
HFMC Wealth specialises in delivering financial planning and wealth management advice.  We take a highly personal approach to advice and conduct each client relationship as a partnership, with client goals and aspirations at the centre of every financial plan created. We are advocates of the use of cash flow planning, to bring planning risks and opportunities to life for clients in a clear and engaging manner.  This allows us to provide our clients with the most appropriate solutions to meet their objectives.

In general, we provide reliable and expert advice for individuals and businesses seeking to achieve five principal financial objectives:
• To co-ordinate and organise their financial affairs, acting as their Personal Finance Director
• To build and preserve their capital
• To manage their cash and borrowings
• To protect them and their family against financial risk
• To manage their businesses more effectively

We are a company that understands that everybody’s needs and objectives are different. Our clients are predominantly professionals, affluent individuals, trustees, business owners and entrepreneurs.  They are frequently time poor and are seeking financial planning and investment management advice.  They may be looking for advice, or are simply trying to simplify their affairs by delegating to trusted advisers. We act for over 1,000 individuals, families, businesses and trusts.

We have been awarded Corporate Chartered Financial Planner status by the Chartered Insurance Institute demonstrating our commitment to the highest degree of technical knowledge, capability and ethical practice.

We additionally deliver investment services, as required, on both an advisory and a discretionary basis. We are able to provide both onshore and offshore custody of assets to our clients recognising that high net worth clients are increasingly living their lives in more than one jurisdiction.

column10:
Established over 30 years ago, our founders each had a simple aligned goal, to provide all our clients and their families with personal, unbiased, and expert financial guidance. Traditional values which still underpin our core beliefs today. 

Our commitment to true financial success is not just about numbers, but about helping our clients achieve their unique life goals, and aspirations while securing their financial future.

Every one of our clients has different requirements and we recognise that life doesn’t always follow the same path, and one size does not fit all. We take the time to understand your aspirations and concerns, creating financial plans that are perfectly tailored to your needs now and in the future.

Our growth and success to date are founded on the reputation that we have built over the last 30 years. Our innovative forward-thinking approach has enabled us to become one of the leading Independent Financial Advice (IFA) firms in Sussex.

We are entrusted with managing over £1.5 billion of clients’ money via our in-house Discretionary Investment Management (DIM) service.

We’ve blended tradition, trust and innovation to create a unique approach, and we understand that your financial aspirations are as individual as you are. That’s why we’re dedicated to providing you with strategies that are time-tested, trustworthy and reflective of the latest developments in the financial planning landscape.

We take the uncertainty out of your finances – with straight-talking advice to help you do more with your money.

Maybe you’ve started to think about your retirement. It could be you’re wondering how to juggle your family’s needs and your own. Or perhaps you just want the reassurance that your money’s working as hard as it can. Whatever the goal, we’ll build you an expert plan to get you there. Because some things are too important to DIY.

Getting help shouldn’t be a hassle, so we’ll pair you with an adviser in minutes. You can chat to them online, on the phone, or face-to-face. And we’ll do it all without an ounce of jargon. It’s smart, faff-free financial advice – on your terms.

column10:
Our vision for Paradigm Norton is based on the fact that ‘we can’t take our money with us’ - that if we look exclusively at money, we only focus on a small part of the picture and hardly scratch the surface of what life is all about. 

Financial planning is about your life and not just your money.

Financial planning isn’t a one-off activity. It’s a journey and it spans a lifetime.
At the heart of what we do is to cause you to reflect and consider what you really want out of life, what are your dreams, hopes, aspirations and passions?

column10:
We are the UK’s number 1 Advised Retirement Income Specialist and we arrange £millions of income options at retirement each week for people around the UK. 

As a company with Diploma qualified Independent Financial Advisers, when you ask us for a quote, one of our dedicated professionals will answer your enquiry, unlike lead generation sites that sell your information on to third party companies.
 
This ensures you get the very best advice from the minute you send your enquiry.

The major advantage we have over many competitors is that we are qualified to offer advice and guidance on the products that best fit with your current circumstances. Many companies aren't authorised to offer advice which can sometimes mean you could choose a product that isn't best suited to you.
 
We have to ensure every product we recommend is entirely in your best interests as we are governed and regulated by the FCA and have to back up each recommendation with a report that justifies the reason we chose a particular product.
 
As we place so much business with the various providers, we get enhanced commission rates which we pass on in savings to you. This means we can usually beat the quote you would get if you went direct to the provider.

We are always on the lookout for bright, talented people and invest heavily in our staff - please take a look at our Careers page for our current vacancies: https://mypensionexpert.com/careers/.

Craven Street Wealth is a leading Independent Chartered Financial Planning and wealth management firm, providing specialist advice to individuals, business owners, trustees, and professionals across the UK.

With a team of 90, including 30 highly qualified Financial Planners, we manage approximately £2 billion in client assets and operate from regional offices in London, Kent, Sussex, Bedfordshire, Dorset, and Oxfordshire. We have been consistently recognised for our expertise and client focus, ranking No. 2 Financial Adviser in the UK in 2024 by FT Adviser, a Financial Times publication.

As part of the Quanta Group, alongside Wealthtime, Wealthtime Classic, and discretionary fund manager Copia Capital, we are backed by AnaCap Financial Partners, with the wider group responsible for approximately £18 billion in client assets.

Our Expertise
We provide comprehensive financial planning services, with specialisms in:

Strategic Wealth Management – Tailored investment strategies to preserve and grow client assets.

Corporate and Business Owner Advisory – Tax-efficient planning, business protection, and succession strategies.

Trustee and Professional Services – Specialist advice for legal professionals, accountants, and trustees.

Retirement & Estate Planning – Structuring assets for financial security and legacy planning.

Tax & Protection Planning – Mitigating risk and ensuring long-term financial resilience.

Craven Street Wealth has built a reputation for successfully integrating acquisitions while maintaining a strong focus on independence, long-term client relationships, and service excellence. 

Our team works in close partnership with professional intermediaries to deliver joined-up financial planning solutions that align with client and business objectives.

To learn more about how we can support you and your clients, visit: www.cravenstreetwealth.com email info@cravenstreetwealth.com or call 0330 320 9280

column10:
Every business will tell you they’re different. The private banks talk about their heritage and their global resources. Traditional stockbrokers will tell you how they can find you the best investments. And financial advisers shout about how they have more technical qualifications than everyone else. But there’s one thing they don’t like talking about…

YOU

We believe the traditional wealth management model is broken. It’s focussed on products, not what they can help you achieve. And it’s serving the needs of those selling these products, rather than those investing in them. Sure, you’ll want to know what to invest in. But will that mean you can spend more time with your family? Will it stop you worrying and make it easier to sleep at night? Will it help you enjoy the retirement you really want? We’ll have a relationship with you, not your money.

NUMBER ONE

10 years ago, we made a decision to do things differently. To break the mould. To be the best at what we do. We scrapped the traditional model and created a new proposition. One that helps our clients achieve the things that matter most to them. What we’ve created is frighteningly simple but it works. We want our clients to make life count.

TODAY

So where are we now, 10 years later? We’re one of the leading and fastest growing financial planning firms in the UK. We’ve won numerous awards and we’re a long way towards our ambition of being number one.

City Asset Management has over 30 years’ experience providing investment services to private clients and families - either directly or through a trusted network of professional financial advisers. Our goal is to preserve and increase investors’ wealth, which is why we value real returns (outperforming inflation) more than relative performance (outperforming a benchmark). All while carefully managing risk and avoiding permanent loss of capital.

For financial advisers: We can manage your clients’ investments with our range of investment solutions (covering different performance targets depending on your clients’ appetite for risk), freeing up your time to focus on nurturing relationships and better understand your clients’ needs.

For individuals: Our responsibility as your wealth manager runs far deeper than just generating portfolio returns. We can help you achieve your unique investment needs and goals through our expert financial planning and investment management.

To find out more about our solutions and why advisers and investors like our approach, visit www.city-asset.co.uk.

At Harbour Rock Capital Limited we are all about delivering financial peace of mind for our clients. Between them, our investment committee members have over 90 industry-recognised qualifications. Each year we help thousands of people with their pensions. And we currently manage over £½ billion in pension savings for our clients. 

People who like to help people

Our staff are regularly trained on the latest financial regulations and more general administration skills. The one thing that cannot be taught is the bit we are most proud of: they genuinely care about people. 

Harbour Rock Capital Limited is a meritocracy, a fantastically flexible environment for people who have the ability to grow and help others to grow with them. We love saying thank you for a job well done and are always interested in what makes our staff tick outside of work. 

The value of sound advice

We currently operate under the Pension Access brand. We have developed a different way of doing things so that everyone can have access to great financial advice for their pension when it suits them, in a clear and simple way.

When it comes to our clients’ savings, we do not think it is right to try and predict the future. Instead, our investment philosophy is based on decades’ worth of historical data and scientific research.

BBT Group Ltd. is a firm of Chartered Financial Planners specialising in retirement planning. With decades of industry experience, our aim is simple - to deliver high-quality, holistic financial advice that helps our clients to achieve their goals.

We recognise that making major financial decisions can feel overwhelming, particularly those that will have an impact on the rest of your life. This is why we work with you, offering guidance and advice that you can trust.

Boolers is a Chartered firm of Financial Planners. To achieve this, we have satisfied rigorous criteria relating to professional qualifications and ethical good practice. We are a progressive, owner managed, independent business and for over 30 years have welcomed clients to our firm, offering advice in the specialist areas of pensions and investments.

We have a Discretionary Investment Management permission, and we also act as pension Trustees for our Self Invested Personal Pensions (SIPP) and our Small Self-Administered Schemes (SSAS).

We look to build long term relationships with our clients and we hope that our site gives you the confidence to take the first steps in what we hope, and expect, to be a long and successful relationship.

column5: David Williams IFA Chartered Financial Planners
column10:
David Williams IFA is an independent firm of Chartered Financial Planners who look beyond the obvious to deliver first class results and service for our clients.

We offer a holistic approach to financial and tax planning. We help clients with their investment, pension and protection needs through their working life and concentrate on maximising their income in retirement. We make extensive use of trusts in tax and inheritance planning and are open-minded in our approach to investment, using a wide range of funds and other structures to moderate risk while delivering solid returns.

As a firm of Chartered Financial Planners, we voluntarily subscribe to the enhanced ethical and professional standards set out by the Chartered Insurance Institute. This represents the 'gold standard' for financial advice in the UK.

We serve a wide range of clients including charities and companies. Corporate services include group protection and benefits arrangements and arranging company pensions. David Williams IFA operates a specialist mortgage business, arranging competitive loans for both residential and investment properties.

David Williams IFA is based in Northampton primarily serving clients around the East Midlands and in London.

clarity is an award-winning firm of chartered financial planners, with offices in London, Woking and Cambridge. We provide a range of services to help people and organisations manage their money, including:

•	strategic financial planning advice

•	investment advice and management 

•	market-leading financial planning and benefits communication technology, including online tools and calculators

We know that everyone’s circumstances are different, so our services are suitably flexible. The majority of our clients choose to work with us on a long-term basis, but we also provide one-off advice if you just need our help for a particular issue. •	tax and business planning

•	estate and inheritance tax planning

Our clients, be they individuals, families, trustees or corporate entities, typically have more challenging and complex requirements. Our goal is to provide a truly personalised service that delivers the best possible outcome for a client's specific requirements now and in the future.

Whilst we specialise in creating and preserving wealth, our approach is simple and practical. We gain a complete understanding of a client's needs, provide initial and ongoing advice to meet desired outcomes and charge fees which are transparent and agreed in advance.

We hold the prestigious Corporate Chartered Financial Planner status which recognises our expertise, professionalism and commitment to providing our clients with the best possible advice.

Rosebridge is a part of Group IFA which draws together the collective knowledge and experience of highly skilled advisers from within four key areas of the financial services industry: private client services; wealth management; specialist pensions; and employee benefits. By working in partnership, our advisers help individuals, trustees and organisations achieve their financial goals through the provision of tailored comprehensive financial planning solutions.

Finura was founded in 2014 with a vision to deliver an exceptional client experience from beginning to end, to become the most highly-referred name in financial services.  We are a multi-disciplinary financial planning practice for private clients, business owners and trustees. 

In order to create the best financial planning firm in the country, we have brought together broad advice permissions, efficient compliance and advanced technology at a highly competitive cost.  In addition, in partnership with Schroders, we have access to the award-winning global and institutional expertise of one of the world’s largest private investment houses.  We work collaboratively to create a real-time house view on global economics, which keeps clients abreast of relevant factors that may impact plans.

Leaning on cutting-edge behavioural finance research and using Lifestyle and Cash Flow modelling software, we see our job as empowering clients to make better financial decisions to meet their lifestyle needs.  Also to collaborate with clients to deliver innovative ideas and a unique plan delivered with integrity and personality.

In 2019, Finura proudly gained the Pensions Transfer Gold Standard:

"Financial advice firms who adopt the Pensions Transfer Gold Standard adhere to a set of principles. As a result you can be confident that you are dealing with an ethical adviser and professional advice firm that has your best interests at heart when receiving financial advice in relation to whether or not you should transfer your pension."

Quote source: The Personal Finance Society, part of the Chartered Insurance Institute group.

At Astute Private Wealth Ltd, we seek to provide first class financial planning and advice to clients across the North West, North Wales and beyond.               

We aim to build strong, enduring relationships with our clients, and take pride in helping them to achieve their goals through comprehensive lifestyle financial planning. We want to provide our clients with confidence for their future, so that they can enjoy their lives now.

We have offices in Ewloe, Liverpool and Knutsford, and have been awarded the title of “Chartered Financial Planners” by the Chartered Insurance Institute.

Established in 1959, Radcliffe & Co, Independent Financial Advisers have been providing Informed, Impartial and Independent Financial Advice to businesses and private clients alike for over 50 years. 

Having expanded through acquisition and organic growth, we are now probably the largest IFA on the South Coast. With 17 advisers possessing a range of expertise, we are well placed to provide expert advice to over 16,000 individuals as we currently do, along with administering pension schemes for over 140 different employers. 

Private client investors benefit from the strategic alliances we have with specialist Investment Managers. 

From pension funds to ISA’s we have a panel of firms that look after our clients’ investments. In addition, Radcliffe Mortgages provides a whole range of independent mortgage advice including Equity Release Schemes. 

We are proud of our independence and the first class service that we provide. We are also committed to re-investing in our communities in order to make them sustainable places of work and leisure. 

We have provided sponsorship to a variety of sporting clubs, including cricket and youth football and the team at Radcliffe through their own individual efforts regularly fund raise for local and national charities. 

To find out how we can help you create a sustainable financial future contact one of our expert team on 02380 222 444.

We are experts in financial advice. Our philosophy is to put our clients at the heart of everything we do. We work with you to support your aspirations, whether that be supporting your organisational strategy, or working with individuals to reduce debt, protect your lifestyle, and increase your wealth. 

For organisations our Lifetime Wealth business can provide advice on business and succession planning, including key person insurance and group pensions. From our 360 DotNet business we can also supply the technology to run your financial business efficiently and effectively. We have offices in Ewloe, Liverpool and Knutsford, and have been awarded the title of “Chartered Financial Planners” by the Chartered Insurance Institute.

ABOUT US

"We believe that top quality independent financial advice is central to helping our clients build a more certain financial future"

Established in 2002 and rated by Plimsoll to be “among the UK’s leading independent financial advisors” (2016 Plimsoll IFA Analysis Report), we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and specialise in providing independent and unbiased whole of market financial advice to individuals, professionals and companies, regarding all aspects of personal and corporate financial planning.

We have built our success upon a reputation for providing high quality and truly impartial advice, based upon our expert knowledge of financial markets and taxation. We offer clients a clearly defined service, transparent fee structure and an effective ongoing service proposition.

OUR VALUES

Well-informed whole of market financial planning is the cornerstone of everything we do. Our core values ensure that we act with the utmost degree of integrity and professionalism and are open and ethical at all times. In essence, we put our clients’ best interests at the heart of the business to ensure that we provide you with the peace of mind that your financial future is more secure as a result of working with us.

Our four key business principles centre around honesty, integrity, reliability and value for money. Our financial advisers and service administrators strive to deliver consistently high standards and are committed to delivering an excellent customer experience.

Strategic Solutions is a multi award winning Chartered firm of Independent Financial Advisers covering the South of England. We have advisers based in Southampton, New Milton, Bournemouth, Wareham, Newton Abbot, Exeter, Sherborne, and Poole. Whether your enquiry is on a personal or corporate basis we understand that the major financial decisions you make have significant and life-changing consequences to your future. It is therefore essential that you seek professional independent financial advice from people you can trust.

The Chartered title we hold is only awarded to the few firms that demonstrate to our professional body a commitment to maintaining the knowledge and capability of their people and abide by a demanding code of ethical practice.

We built Strategic Solutions to transform the perceptions of the public by providing a comprehensive financial planning service focused on the long-term goals and aspirations of our clients and putting client interests centre stage. Our range of financial planning services are tailored to the unique needs, goals and circumstances of each individual from creating personalised full financial plans for those with accumulated wealth, through to helping individuals take their first steps in saving.

Consequently we work with a wide range of clients from all walks of life. Recent changes in our market has resulted in many advisers abandoning the “man in the street” and dealing only with high net worth individuals. We made the decision not to follow that path but to ensure we were able to provide advice, help and guidance to anyone who needs it.

Profit is never our main driver. Delighted clients are. We believe passionately that professional, expert financial planning and guidance makes a huge difference, even to those of modest wealth. As such we seek to help whomever we can to achieve greater and more sustainable long term financial security. 

We currently look after around £600 million of our clients money.

Proudly delivering expert advice for over 40 years. We are passionate about maximising life enhancing outcomes for our clients.

Frenkel Topping provide legal guidance, financial planning and asset management advice for clients who’ve suffered a serious accident or personal injury. We’ve more than 30 years’ experience of listening to their needs, finding the right investment and making sure their money lasts a lifetime.

Securing damages for anyone who’s suffered a life-changing event is often a complex task, which comes with enormous responsibility. 95% of our clients are so impressed with our services that they stick with us throughout their lifetimes.

We have a proven track record in safeguarding the financial future of such clients by assessing their financial situation and helping them secure the maximum compensation settlement they are entitled to. We then carefully invest their damages to protect their independence and quality of life in the long term.

We have a team of carefully selected consultants across England and Wales. They are renowned not only for their expertise and knowledge in the sector, but also for demonstrating a great deal of empathy and compassion to clients who are often experiencing extremely difficult times.

Our specialists can help you secure the best compensation settlement for your clients by compiling key reports under our range of:

Expert witness services
Loss of earnings
Pension losses
Welfare benefits
Court of Protection and the Office of the Public Guardian
Periodical payment orders
Personal injury trusts 
Accommodation reports 
Training and conference programme

column10:
Proudly delivering expert advice for over 40 years. We are passionate about maximising life enhancing outcomes for our clients.

Frenkel Topping provide legal guidance, financial planning and asset management advice for clients who’ve suffered a serious accident or personal injury. We’ve more than 30 years’ experience of listening to their needs, finding the right investment and making sure their money lasts a lifetime.

Securing damages for anyone who’s suffered a life-changing event is often a complex task, which comes with enormous responsibility. 95% of our clients are so impressed with our services that they stick with us throughout their lifetimes.

We have a proven track record in safeguarding the financial future of such clients by assessing their financial situation and helping them secure the maximum compensation settlement they are entitled to. We then carefully invest their damages to protect their independence and quality of life in the long term.

We have a team of carefully selected consultants across England and Wales. They are renowned not only for their expertise and knowledge in the sector, but also for demonstrating a great deal of empathy and compassion to clients who are often experiencing extremely difficult times.

Our specialists can help you secure the best compensation settlement for your clients by compiling key reports under our range of:

Expert witness services
Loss of earnings
Pension losses
Welfare benefits
Court of Protection and the Office of the Public Guardian
Periodical payment orders
Personal injury trusts 
Accommodation reports 
Training and conference programme

Established in 2000, Fiscal Engineers is a multi-award winning boutique wealth management firm, accredited by the Institute of Financial Planning and a ‘big four’ global accounting firm.  With a Midlands heritage, we have offices in Nottingham, London and Birmingham – advising clients throughout the UK.

Specialists in delivering family office services for top tier professionals approaching retirement and entrepreneurs exiting private-equity backed businesses, we provide a dedicated service for those at the point of transition with substantial investment needs.

We support our clients through these key financial moments in their lives by helping them realise the outcomes they want.  Our experience in managing transitional change has taught us the most effective ways to maximise return from these milestone events, freeing our clients from the day-to-day worry of managing, protecting and growing their wealth.

Working alongside internationally respected academics, Fiscal Engineers was recognised in 2012 for its contribution to the sector by undertaking studies in trust and confidence post the global financial crisis that has negatively impacted so many.

Fiscal Engineers is a ‘relationship’ system built on mutual respect, trust, listening and understanding.  It is our mission to help our clients achieve the perfect money/life balance.

Proudly delivering expert advice for over 40 years. We are passionate about maximising life enhancing outcomes for our clients.

Frenkel Topping provide legal guidance, financial planning and asset management advice for clients who’ve suffered a serious accident or personal injury. We’ve more than 30 years’ experience of listening to their needs, finding the right investment and making sure their money lasts a lifetime.

Securing damages for anyone who’s suffered a life-changing event is often a complex task, which comes with enormous responsibility. 95% of our clients are so impressed with our services that they stick with us throughout their lifetimes.

We have a proven track record in safeguarding the financial future of such clients by assessing their financial situation and helping them secure the maximum compensation settlement they are entitled to. We then carefully invest their damages to protect their independence and quality of life in the long term.

We have a team of carefully selected consultants across England and Wales. They are renowned not only for their expertise and knowledge in the sector, but also for demonstrating a great deal of empathy and compassion to clients who are often experiencing extremely difficult times.

Our specialists can help you secure the best compensation settlement for your clients by compiling key reports under our range of:

Expert witness services
Loss of earnings
Pension losses
Welfare benefits
Court of Protection and the Office of the Public Guardian
Periodical payment orders
Personal injury trusts 
Accommodation reports 
Training and conference programme

PFP Wealth Group Ltd is a Senior Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management.

At PFP Wealth we place our clients at the heart of the business and believe that the best way to give personal financial advice is through our team of Professional Financial Advisers. 

We understand that regular client contact and financial reviews are the key to successful financial planning simply because the world does not stay the same. PFP Wealth Ltd exists to guide and support our clients throughout their financial life and help them to achieve their financial goals.

Established in 1973, Marshall Wooldridge has grown into one of the top 50 regional independent brokers in the country. We have built an enviable reputation of technical competence across all classes of commercial and sports insurances.

We pride ourselves upon providing a customer focused, service proposition to all of our clients delivered by experienced, qualified insurance professionals. Our commitment to service and quality across the business has been recognised by the Chartered Insurance Institute having awarded us Chartered status. From small beginnings our business now spreads across 3 locations in Yeadon, close to Leeds and from 2014 an office based in Rotherham, South Yorkshire. We currently employ over 55 members of staff, placing premiums in excess of £22m annually. We advise on all aspects of insurance but are primarily commercial and industrial specialists where we aim to deliver tailored risk solutions.

As our business continues to evolve, a number of valuable and successful partnerships have been forged including with the English & Wales Cricket Board (ECB), and Deliciously Yorkshire who promote the interests of food and drink companies in Yorkshire and Humberside. We are extremely proud of our expertise in the sports, waste and food and drink sectors.

Milecross Financial was established in 2005 in Newtownards, County Down. Since then it has grown into one of the largest financial advice practices in the UK with a multitude of advisers working from branches and offices throughout Northern Ireland, Scotland & England.
 
For almost 20 years, we’ve been helping homeowners make informed financial decisions, during both good times and challenging times.

We provide an ethical, transparent and friendly service on a face to face, telephony or online basis. Whether it’s first home advice, protecting what matters, saving for your children’s future, or looking forward to your retirement, we can help you plan ahead. Our philosophy is to build long term relationships based on mutual openness and trust that reassures you of our commitment to excellent customer outcomes. Together, we look at your current financial circumstances and align this with your objectives providing a bespoke package that will evolve throughout your life.
 
We are an appointed representative of The Openwork Partnership, one of the UK’s largest networks of financial advisers. This provides us access to pensions, investments, mortgages and protection products from some of the largest brands in the UK. It also enables us to access payment and reconciliation services, IT and regulatory support when required. Their support in the background enables us to focus on our clients and ensure we give them the best possible advice. 

YOUR HOME MAY BE REPOSSESSED IF YOU DO NOT KEEP UP REPAYMENTS ON YOUR MORTGAGE.
The value of investments and any income from them can fall as well as rise and you may not get back the original amount invested.

Milecross Financial Solutions is an appointed representative of The Openwork Partnership, a trading style of Openwork Limited which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Approved by The Openwork Partnership on 11/10/2024

We are an Independent Financial Adviser with a wealth of experience in providing suitable investments, pensions and other financial products such as mortgages and protection plans, both for businesses and individuals alike.

Our aim is to help your finances perform the best they possibly can. Whether you are looking for your first mortgage, or planning your hard earned retirement we can help you plan for the best possible outcome.

Our financial planning is supported by the latest technology to ensure information is available to you when you need it, in the format you prefer. We also work with many financial research organisations who constantly keep ahead of world events, and assess trends going forward based on previous market behaviour.

Advice from Markland Hill Wealth is unique. Our Directors have vast experience of both the financial services industry and the world of commerce. We know what our clients want because we have been clients. We’ve seen what outperforming the markets can mean to people who lead real lives in the UK today.

Come on the journey with us and let’s make your finances work as hard as possible, together. You as our client, us as your coach.

We look forward to working for you.

At Navigation Wealth Management Ltd, a Managing Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management, we focus and pride ourselves upon maintaining long-term, trusted relationships with our clients, showing distinct quality, integrity and excellence, which in turn gives both private and business clients financial peace of mind. 

It is our personal goal to help all of our clients plan holistically, considering everything from ensuring they and their families/businesses are protected, to aim for superior returns on their investments and pensions, to asset protection and tax mitigation. 
In simple terms, "Holistic Wealth Management Planning", which is tailored for the clients in question based on current Government legislation.

•Investing for capital growth or capital preservation
•Investing for income
•Planning for Retirement
•Protecting wealth
•Protecting lifestyles against risk
•Mitigating tax liabilities
•Planning exit of a business*
•Contingency planning

The value of an investment with St. James's Place will be directly linked to the performance of the funds you select and the value can therefore go down as well as up. You may get back less than you invested. 

*This is likely to involve the referral to services that are separate and distinct to those offered by St. James's Place

The levels and bases of taxation and reliefs from taxation can change at any time. The value of any tax reliefs depends on individual circumstances.

Navigation Wealth Management is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority).
The 'St. James's Place Partnership' and the titles 'Partner' and 'Partner Practice' are marketing terms used to describe St. James's Place representatives.

At KBA The Financial Planning Company our ethos is we want to “Help People Have Better Lives”. That relates to our clients and customers, our team and our local communities.
 
For our clients, we specialise in helping them reach their financial goals through providing them powerful financial and lifestyle plans alongside a cashflow forecast. We help them with personal and corporate financial planning in the areas of planning for retirement, savings and investment management, protecting your income and your legacy, estate and inheritance tax planning including business property relief and agricultural relief and also mortgage advice. We also specialise in corporate advice for company pensions and protecting your business and your financial future. We pride ourselves on creating financial plans and cashflow forecasts and not just looking at the products so you can make an informed decision on the impact of any financial decision and ensure your future is secure and you are clear about where you are going. 
 
Having been in the industry since 1987, we have first-hand experience of the ever-changing world and how it can affect our clients in the long term. We will discuss with you ‘What are your aspirations for the future? For your retirement? Have you thought about how your family or business would cope financially if you were not there? Will your children be able to get on the property ladder in the future?’ 
 
As well as running our core business as KBA The Financial Planning Company we also look after three Yorkshire Building Society Agencies, in Nantwich, Bury and Southport. As an agency for YBS we’re here to help more people save for the things that matter and buy their own home. 
 
Financial Planning is never straight forward, and everyone's circumstances are different so why not take advantage of a financial review and get acquainted with one of our Financial Planners to put your mind at ease

As Independent Financial Advisers we are free to advise on financial products available from all product providers available to us. 

We use advanced computer software to research, compare and source the most suitable products available to suit your curent needs and circumstances. We are thus able to make arrangements to maximize the benefits to our clients.

You will get our help to review your existing financial situation and reach a realistic assessment of your likely needs. For this, you will need to set aside some time to talk to us - the first meeting is free without cost or obligation. We will find out together if we are able to proceed and also to discuss on what basis you would like to pay us for our service. 

Depending on your instructions we will carry out a ‘needs analysis’ based on your current situation, and taking into account any specific plans and / or targets you may have. We will then advise you on anything from a short term financial objective to a lifetime financial plan.

We may recommend solutions that clients are unlikely to consider for themselves. All our proposals will be fully explained and discussed and the cost of our advice and whether this was based on payiong a fee or by being remmunerated by commission would be disclosed to you.

column10:
Do you live in the North East?

Are you struggling to understand your pensions?

Want to know when you can afford to retire?

We can help...

We'll put a date on when you can retire and remove any worries about running out of money.

For 20 years our local team of specialist pension & retirement planning advisers have helped thousands of people make sense of their options. 

Many found out they could retire years earlier than expected – our record’s 12 years earlier!

We focus on you and what you want from life. 

Then we'll work out how to use your financial assets to get you there.

One person's happy ever after could be pottering in the garden or seeing more of the grandchildren. Another’s could be bungee jumping in South Africa. 

Similarly, everyone’s financial assets are unique to them, whether based on property, pensions, savings, or investments. 

Our job is to map the route from these to your happiness.

We can look after funds and investments long-term and provide a Protection Estate Planning Service to ensure financial assets are protected in the future.  This includes Wills, Lasting Power of Attorney, Will Trusts to protect your assets against care fees and more.

Our services also include Equity Release to access tax-free cash to fund your retirement. 

Our initial meeting is no-cost, no-obligation and there's absolutely no pressure. 

This allows you the time and space to decide if our service is right for you.

So, when you're ready give us a call on 01642 52 55 11.

You can also register for one of our free workshops, see our Careers page and get our expert insights here - https://linktr.ee/joslinrhodes

column10:
Established in 1999, DGS is a  firm of experienced Chartered Financial Planners and Independent Financial Advisers (IFAs), possessing extensive market knowledge. 

We provide independent financial advice, planning and guidance to individuals, as well as supporting corporate clients with employee benefits solutions and company specific financial advice.  

We support clients nationally and have four offices based in London, Hertfordshire and the Midlands.  

Corporate Solutions

DGS can advise on and implement a range of employee benefit solutions, as well as reviewing your existing arrangements.  We ensure your company pays a competitive premium for insurance products i.e private health care, group income protection etc and that you receive a high quality ongoing advice and support service. 

We work with companies ranging from 10 up to currently around 7,000 employees.

We also support companies with their obligations under  pensions auto enrolment, as well as providing advice & support directly to your employees (financial education), showing them how the benefits on offer support their own financial objectives. 

Individual Financial Advice and Wealth Management

We provide independent financial advice, planning and guidance in areas such as: 

-Investments
-Retirement planning
-Options at retirement
-Protection
-Mortgage advice
-Long term care planning
-Wills & estate planning
-Equity release

Each client receives a solution that suits their particular requirement, enabling us to deliver a truly unique bespoke experience.  

We pride ourselves on being friendly, approachable, ethical and knowledgeable, with a people focused service delivered without jargon.

We're TFA Trusted Financial Advice, an award winning independent, whole of market financial advice firm specialising in advice for individuals, families and businesses on all matters relating to pensions, investments, protection insurance and mortgages.

WE OFFER TRUSTED ADVICE ON ...

 All types of Mortgages
 Equity Release & later life lending
 Pensions and retirement planning
 Investment planning
 ESG, Ethical and Impact Investing
 Protection insurance such as Life Insurance, Income Protection & Critical Illness

We know that planning for our future can be daunting and that taking financial advice can change our clients' lives. So, you can rely on us to use our financial knowledge and expertise to deliver good outcomes for our clients.

HOW DO WE WORK WITH OUR CLIENTS?

We provide our advice through three service offerings. We’ll agree with you the service offering which best meets your needs, but don’t worry, it’s very easy to flex up or down if your circumstances change.

 Our Wealth Management Service for clients who require a close working relationship to meet their objectives
 Our Financial Planning Service for most of our clients who would like to receive regular advice and planning support to reach their objectives
 Our Specific Advice Service is suited to clients requiring focused advice or products to deal with particular issues in isolation and who do not need ongoing advice

We offer these via:

 Face to face in person at a location of your choice
 Face to face via video
 Remotely via telephone

But WHY do our clients REALLY work with us? 

There's one reason that stands out above all others: our clients are at the heart of what we do

We have a long history of providing client focused, trusted independent financial and mortgage advice to both individuals, families and businesses.  This ensures our clients receive the right product for their circumstances, let's hear what our clients have to say.

At Swann Financial, a Managing Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management, our dedicated team of advisers have a wide range of specialist knowledge & experience that helps fulfil all of our client’s individual wants & needs.

Our aim here at Swann Financial is to provide a meaningful relationship with each of our clients. It is our duty as your financial adviser to make sure you are looked after for your current & future circumstances. 

For our clients this includes having an yearly annual review (or more frequent if required) catch up with their personal adviser, to make sure everything is on track with their original plans. They have direct contact details to their adviser, so there is no need to wait to ask those important questions; they can also have meetings in the comfort of their home.

Each of our expert advisers have their own specific skills & advisory sets, this ensures that we can deliver the right solution for each of our clients. As each clients circumstances are different, we make sure they have the right adviser for them.

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

If you need any advice on any of our services please contact us on 01295 275269 or visit www.swannfinancial.co.uk

Established in 1906 and with over 115 years of history behind us, we have joined forces with MHA, one of the largest firms of accountants, tax and business advisers in the UK, to provide new and existing clients across the country with a high quality, service led approach to financial services.

Our new business name, MHA Caves Wealth, reflects both the nature of our new association but also the much broader portfolio of services that we now offer; although we shall remain proud members of the London Stock Exchange, we are not just a stockbroking firm.

Working in tandem with MHA, we endeavour to further enhance the services that we are able to provide to our clients, leveraging their expertise in areas such as personal tax and corporate advice.

Established in 1906, we are one of the oldest surviving firms of independent stockbrokers and investment managers in the UK, experience which enables us to help our clients to make the right investment decisions and giving them peace of mind today, tomorrow and for the future.

Our independence is of great importance to us.  It means that there are no external influences being brought to bear and therefore, every piece of advice is given with only our clients best interest in mind.

We believe this is why we have been able to celebrate over a century of success.

There are many independent financial advisers, but few offer a unique approach to you and your finances. Providing advice since 1987, we are able to offer our clients a breadth of experience, but also a forward looking approach - no matter what the conditions.

Lewis tends to focus on the attainment of income from investments either now or to be achieved at a specific point in the future. 

Our property syndicates have proven to be an excellent tool and form part of our recommended portfolio.

Our proposition is unique.  We believe that most people are best served with a conservative portfolio of real assets.  A strong combination of a small, but refined number of stockmarket investment funds, together with diversification through our well managed property syndicates, provides the potential for longer term dependable returns not offered elsewhere.

We are confident that we can meet most objectives through this combination.  We use a common sense approach to investment and this applies whether the money is your own, in a trust fund or in a pension wrapper.

Lewis also offers comprehensive employee benefits consultancy to small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs)
