Connor Broadley is an independent, owner-managed company based in Mayfair, specialising in wealth management for private clients, and employee benefit consultancy for corporates.

Connor Broadley’s approach to wealth management is unusual in that it places equal emphasis on high quality financial planning advice and investment management expertise. This is because, in our experience, financial success requires good planning, a clear strategy, and excellent investment execution, with each informing the other. Our conviction in the importance of knowing our clients, and commitment to their individual holistic financial success, means we don’t provide investment management to others on a wholesale or third-party basis.

Our team of employee benefit consultants advises companies, big and small, on how to devise, source, implement and maintain the right benefit programs for them, and communicate them effectively. As with wealth management, it is our service which defines us.

Across our business, the ethos boils down to this: our clients should love us. We believe in personable, diligent, attentive one-to-one service and excellent communication. From this flows trust, and from trust, long-term relationships, to everyone’s benefit.

Our client base is diverse, but the creative industries are well represented amongst both private individuals and corporates. This burgeoning sector, which is increasingly recognised for its contribution to the UK economy, brings a vibrancy of its own to our business.

Clark Gillone aim to provide the highest standard of Independent Financial Advice. Our comprehensive range of services include advice on Investments, Pensions, Protection, Savings, Mortgages, and Estate Planning. 

Clark Gillone holds the prestigious title of Chartered Financial Planners. There are very few such organisations in the UK and we are proud to be the largest independent firm in Scotland to have been awarded this status. It is a clear indication of our commitment to professionalism and to ensuring that all our advisers are suitably trained and qualified in their given areas of responsibility.

Primarily, our service is aimed at establishing long term relationships with our clients and our fee and/or commission based remuneration is structured accordingly. Therefore, whether you are a new client, or one who has been with us from the start, you will receive the same quality of service.

James McKenzie Wills Limited is a specialist Will writing firm.  We have clients in all business sectors throughout the UK. Our services are offered  through corporate schemes to a growing number of companies.

With over 15 years of experience writing Wills, James McKenzie was established in 2004 as a dedicated Will writing company.

James McKenzie’s approach to writing Wills is very simple. We want to offer an outstanding service and make the process as easy and straightforward as possible. 

We work on a fixed fee basis, so irrespective of the time taken to complete the process, or the number of clauses required in the Wills, there are no hidden extras. We always look to future proof our clients’ Wills as much as possible, so include additional executors, trustees, guardians and beneficiaries as a matter of course.

Unlike many Solicitors and Will writers, we do not appoint ourselves as Executors, preferring our clients to appoint close friends and family members instead, which can save thousands of pounds in unnecessary legal fees after death. Furthermore, all our consultants are able to advise clients on the best ways to limit their exposure to Inheritance Tax.

"Making a will shouldn’t be a difficult or confusing procedure. I created James McKenzie to take the stress and complexities out of the will writing process" Gareth Briscoe – Owner

For further information please contact us on 020 7193 2060 or at www.james-mckenzie.co.uk

We are a Multi-award winning, boutique wealth management firm. Our experienced chartered financial planners provide bespoke, truly independent financial advice based on their clients' values, objectives and goals.  

We spend a lot of time listening to clients, fully understanding their  financial "must haves",  and only then recommending clear and impartial advice around planning, investments, retirement income and so on. 

We aim to deliver a service that is easily understood and better able to achieve individuals, families and companies financial goals.  Sometimes called a holistic approach to financial planning, that means an investment strategy is only a part of the broader equation.

Our job isn't complete when a client’s strategy is implemented. We work with clients over the years, as their life plans are refined and change through circumstance.  We conduct at least annual reviews to make sure our clients are on track and continue to create, preserve and protect their core wealth. 

Our specialist areas include:

◦ Wealth management
◦ Comprehensive financial planning
◦ Tax planning
◦ Retirement and pension planning
◦ Post-retirement planning
◦ Investment planning
◦ Estate planning and inheritance tax mitigation (including Wills, Lasting and enduring Powers of Attorney forms etc)

Who are we?

Invest Southwest, Independent Financial Advisers was founded in 2007 and is regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA 469547).

Our highly experienced Financial Advisers are located throughout the Southwest region and are fully qualified to give financial advice. Each adviser subscribes to the FCA code of conduct and have Statements of Professional Standing as evidence they meet standards set by the Regulator.  Our advisers are supported by staff based at our Head office in Taunton and also at our Weston-Super-Mare office. All our dedicated staff, work to ensure the process of advising you on your financial matters, runs smoothly from start to finish.

We offer the best solutions from the entire market to suit your financial needs, be they personal, family or business. The key thing is to build a relationship to understand and help you achieve your financial goals. Which is why a dedicated adviser is assigned to provide you Advice…For Life.  

Why choose Invest Southwest?

Since 2007, Invest Southwest has been focused on helping you understand and plan for your financial future, both now and longer term. By providing you an Independent Financial Advice service, we are able to consider a wide range of financial strategies and products. We continually review the whole market, to ensure our advice best meets your needs and objectives.  If this approach identifies that the best advice is to do nothing, that is what we will recommend.

Our Services include:

• Investment & Pensions Advice
• Gifts & Trusts
• Estate planning
• Inheritance tax planning
• Long-term care
• Protection cover
• Mortgage & Equity Release advice
• Wills & Probate - Visit our sister company Will Management Services https://www.willmanagement.co.uk

Read our reviews at www.reviews.co.uk/company-reviews/store/investsouthwest-co-uk

We have established an enviable reputation with both our clients and other professionals with whom we work, for delivering in depth, expert advice and personal service, tailored to the needs of each individual.

Specialists in corporate and private wealth management, Ryley Wealth Management Ltd was established by David Ryley in 1999 with the vision to manage, protect and grow our clients’ wealth throughout their lifetime and for generations to come.

Our knowledgeable and expert advisers forge longstanding relationships with our clients based on trust and understanding to provide a truly holistic financial planning service tailored to individual needs.

Working with business owners and C-level executives, from SMEs to large multi-nationals, we create a financial plan covering all aspects of corporate wealth management: pensions, protection for directors, key employees and shareholders, tax reliefs and aspects of exit strategy planning.

For the families we look after, our services encompass tax-efficient savings and investment planning, retirement planning, estate planning and intergenerational wealth management and protection.

We create a financial plan structured to meet your needs and reviewed at least once a year to help you stay on track, giving you the financial freedom to enjoy the lifestyle you have always wanted.

The value of an investment with St. James's Place will be directly linked to the performance of the funds you select and the value can therefore go down as well as up. You may get back less than you invested.

Taxation rules can change at any time and are dependent on individual circumstances.

The Partner Practice is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority) for the purpose of advising solely on the Group's wealth management products and services, more details of which are set out on the Group's website at www.sjp.co.uk/products. The 'St. James's Place Partnership' and the titles 'Partner' and 'Partner' Practice are marketing terms used to describe St. James's Place representatives.

At Eastwood Financial Services Ltd we pride ourselves on careful financial planning and providing sound advice and support to guide you through the twists and turns of life.

Based in West Yorkshire for over 40 years, we are an independent firm of advisers providing unrestricted advice and access to a wide range of financial services and financial planning for a diverse range of private and business clients.  We have also been awarded Corporate Chartered status by the Chartered Insurance Institute which is the gold standard for our industry.

Building long term relationships with our clients and gaining their trust and confidence is at the heart of what we do. We aim to achieve good outcomes for all of our clients at all times. The integrity and professionalism of our staff, combined with our systems and controls, enables us to succeed here.

We are a Private Client Manager operating for over 20 years, our experienced relationship managers are supported by investment management and client service teams.  In addition to a choice of portfolios services, we also run a suite of six investment funds, which form the ‘building blocks’ of our discretionary management proposition.  Each fund has a different objective making them ideally suited to use in diversified portfolios designed to provide a balance between risk and reward.

For clients with needs outside our service offering, we collaborate with other professional advisers, such as solicitors and accountants, to deliver holistic solutions. This has led to the formation of a number of close working relationships.

Our funds are also available for use by advisers and wealth managers for use in their client portfolios.

With combined lifetimes of unrivalled experience in what it takes to accumulate and pass on wealth, Legacy is Northern Ireland’s leading provider of high net worth wealth management services. Legacy provide comprehensive financial planning with an unsurpassed level of personal care to both private individuals, families and businesses seeking to actualise their aspirations. Legacy draws on their empathetic and expert team of trusted advisers and extensive support team, to partner with and proactively anticipate client needs to maximise their success into a trusted strategy for generations to come.

Due to increasing demand for tailored, high quality service from its clients across all areas of life and wealth, Legacy has launched and provides two flagship services – Legacy Lifetime and Legacy Business. 

Legacy Lifetime serves high net worth private clients, combining financial planning with investment and risk management to seek more than just a return on investment, but to see an individual’s life return a legacy. Backed by Legacy’s bespoke, revolutionary investment philosophy – Legacy Lifetime methodically combines expert financial organisation, investment, accountability, objectivity, proactivity, education, and partnership to deliver lasting success for individuals who want to turn their hard work into a heritage. 

Legacy Business serves local businesses, entrepreneurs and directors in offering a completely integrated client solution with a full range of corporate financial services covering group risk management, workplace pensions, financial planning and employee engagement.  
 
Legacy takes pride in establishing life long relationships with their clients that often span generations of family and business. If you’d like to take the first step in turning your life into a legacy, we’d love to hear from you. 

Expect More.

UK's first online Independent Financial Adviser (IFA).

Meet your personal adviser in one click, keep all your documents and reports in our unique CRM, book your free initial consultation anytime. 

Financial advice in the UK is one of the most inefficient and technology-lacking sectors, with majority of business being conducted out of small private practices. This leads to high commissions, meaning that for many people, such service becomes inaccessible. We are proud to offer partnerships and support local IFAs across the UK today, feel free to reach out to us to find out more. 

Here at Fintuity we optimise every step of the advisory process to bring you a good quality service at a fraction of the cost of your local financial adviser.

We provide comprehensive advice on investment, pension, mortgage, life insurance, general insurance, inheritance tax planning. Depends on your needs we can either concentrate on a specific areas as to retirement planning or new ISA investment advice or provide a full financial review and create a bespoke financial plan for you and your family.

If you require a specific service which we can not provide at the moment we will refer you to one of our partners integrated on our platform, you will remain our customer and receive all benefits as any other client of Fintuity.

At Trinity Lifetime Partners we aim to inspire new thinking in order to provide our clients with the insights and information they need to make the right financial decisions. Our collaborative approach across the Trinity Lifetime team and our partnerships ensure our clients have access to and support from a wide range of experts.

Underpinning everything we do is our highly developed due diligence process which allows us to work with our clients to bring a fresh approach to all aspects of financial planning. We aspire to drive best practice across the industry by highlighting the high standards to which we hold ourselves.

The time we take to understand our clients’ situations in order to create robust financial plans and the tools we use, such as Trinity Financial Forecast to stress-test their adaptability, supports us in our goal of becoming the most trusted advisers for long-term financial planning.

Atlantic Swiss is the UKs largest talent Financial Agency and has earned a well founded reputation assisting some of the top names in Television, Film, Music and Sport. 

We manage over 350 international personalities involved in the media and sporting industries, looking after every aspect of their financial life including private and professional financial management. This encompasses all personal and business advice and strategies, in the UK, Europe, USA and multiple offshore locations. 

We work closely with the client’s accountants, lawyers and agents to insure total financial clarity and efficiency.

Gracechurch Wealth Management LLP is one of the largest Independent Financial Advisers in the Milton Keynes area. We are proud not only of our record in providing high quality advice, but also in developing systems to ensure that our clients receive the very highest levels of ongoing advice and service.

We are a multi-award winning, lifestyle-based, Chartered financial planning and wealth management boutique. Since 2004 we have delivered goal-based planning to business owners and those approaching or in retirement.

𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲

We deliver a genuinely unique and premium service to business owners and people planning their retirement. Our expert team will help you understand your objectives and create a financial planning strategy to live your best life through the smart management of your money. 

This is achieved through our Financialsense Coaching programme, a money concierge service that aligns our clients’ goals and objectives with a financial plan that helps them make smart decisions and live the life they want to live, whatever happens.

𝗪𝗲 𝗽𝘂𝘁 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗯𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝘀

Specialising in helping mature business owners, we allow you to understand what your best life looks like and help you live it. We also work with those who are getting ready to retire by understanding your objectives and planning for a fulfilling lifestyle beyond work.

𝗪𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 “𝗻𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗹 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗱𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝘄𝗲𝗹𝗹”. 

By this, we mean you will have accumulated wealth, have needs that are sometimes complex, are busy with work and life, and need a trusted adviser who can handle the financial tasks you need to delegate. 

𝗦𝗼𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁

We do so much more than simply provide advice on tax savings and investments. We’re financial and lifestyle planners; that means we’re here to coach and help you through major decisions. We’ll challenge and push you when you need it, and inspire you every step of the way.

Our team are experts and we’re proud to be Chartered financial planners recognised with multiple awards. We offer independent, honest advice and deliver ultimate confidence and peace of mind.

DB Wood are a Financial Planning, Investment Management and independent Insurance Brokerage.

Founded in 1976, and located in the heart of Newark on Trent, we constantly strive to improve our people and processes, putting clients at the centre of everything we do. We are a business formed on relationships and trust, employing a team that share in the same values and culture.

We believe that what differentiates us is the deep understanding of “why” we do what we do, not simply “what” or “how” we do it. This philosophy drives our passion to ensure we deliver our clients’ objectives with clarity, discipline and consistency, allowing them to concentrate on enjoying their life.

We aim to offer direction and control by planning for financial security and delivering confidence. We provide choices on the most effective ways to meet your future aspirations. Your planning should be visible and real, and above all interesting, exciting and thought provoking. Together we develop a clear plan, centred around you.

We spend a significant amount of time listening to you discovering where you are now, and where you want to be. Life changes, and so it is crucial that we build planning, investment and risk strategies adaptable to your circumstances.

All this is achieved with a simple, transparent approach where we regularly review your planning journey. We believe that life is for living, and in working together to develop our ideas to deliver your objectives.

Broom Consultants Ltd. has been providing comprehensive advice to our clients for almost 30 years.

As an Independent Financial Adviser (IFA) our clients often need advice in many areas. This includes pensions, investments, trusts, estate planning, mortgages plus all the various tax implications from the myriad of practical solutions available.

We have a large team with many experts specialising in their own particular field. Reassuringly when you work with one Broom Consultants Ltd Adviser you will be given access, via our internal team to this in-depth range of expert knowledge and services. This complements each of our professional advisers’ own expertise to improve your financial outcomes, allowing us to provide you with market-leading advice and implement imaginative solutions to achieve your goals.

Planning for a secure future whether for yourself, your family or your business is one of the most important steps you will ever take. It is important to regularly review your financial situation to take advantage of any developments in both your own circumstances as well as in legislation and tax law. If there are changes in your circumstances, such as starting a family, changing jobs, starting your own business or receiving an inheritance, a review of your financial goals and objectives is crucial.

Future Wealth Management is a Senior Partner Practice of St. James’s Place Wealth Management, who are regarded as one of the leading wealth management organisations in the UK. We appreciate that you are unique, with your own financial principles, which is why we will tailor the services and recommendations that we make specifically to you. It is fundamental that we get to know our clients well - and they get to know us – so that we are able to work together and forge long-term relationships built on mutual trust and understanding. 

•Investment Planning
•Retirement Planning
•Inheritance Tax Planning
•Protection for you, your family or your business
•Helping you arrange a mortgage or re-mortgage
•Tax planning

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

The value of an investment with St. James's Place may rise as well as fall. You may get back less than you invested.

The Partner Practice is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority). The 'St. James's Place Partnership' and the titles 'Partner' and 'Partner Practice' are marketing terms used to describe St. James's Place representatives. Future Wealth Management is a trading name of Future Financial Wealth LLP.

column10:
Founded in Worcester in 2014 but with a growing national footprint, we design and build financial plans for private individuals, business owners and corporate clients that fit perfectly with their unique requirements and needs. We focus on doing things properly and care passionately about the people we look after so, whether it’s your retirement planning, your mortgage and property arrangements, or building and managing your wealth, you know that you can speak to us with confidence.
 
Bringing together a wealth of financial services experience, knowledge and best practice, we’re a truly independent, full service, Chartered Financial Planner, dedicated to achieving and setting the highest industry standards. Committed to the wellbeing of our clients, staff, the environment and our community, we’re building a sustainable advice business for today that will help shape the advice business of tomorrow.
 
We’re growing, through organic, referral driven, client attraction and acquisition, with most of our clients either finding us directly or through the recommendations of others; through the recruitment of high-quality employed and self-employed financial advisers keen to find a stable, supportive and dynamic home, where good governance and client centricity provide the firmest of foundations; and through the provision of an elegant “retirement pathway” for advisers seeking to leave the industry whilst securing an appropriate, empathetic succession plan for their clients.
 
We’re proud of the business we’re building and stand by the beliefs upon which it was set. We believe in integrity, authenticity and meaning, the importance of compassion, respect and kindness; in our responsibilities to others and the role of philanthropy, charity and harmony; in humility and dependability and in our power to empower people, helping them to live the best lives possible, always bespoke to their dreams and aspirations.

We are Independent Financial advisers operating from offices in Manchester City Centre and Lymm, Cheshire and are passionate about what we do. 

Our business is owned by the people who work in it. We build and maintain long term relationships because our future success is closely aligned with that of our clients. 

As one of the first firms in the UK to be awarded Chartered Status, a prestigious award that recognises our commitment to professionalism and fair treatment of clients, we are committed to the highest standards.

For over 40 years FPC has been helping business owners, senior executives and private investors achieve and maintain financial independence, provide for those who rely on them, and live life well. 

Our areas of expertise include specialist advice on investment planning, pensions, retirement planning, business exit or succession planning, estate planning, philanthropy, and managing major life changes such as bereavement or divorce.

Our independent status means our clients get unbiased, best advice – always. 
FPC was also one of the first financial planning firms in the UK to be awarded Chartered Status in 2008. Regarded as the ‘gold standard’ in our sector, Chartered status demonstrates a high standard of professionalism and acts as evidence of our commitment to excellence for our clients, partners, and employees.

New clients often approach us at a critical point when an event such as a potential sale of a business, life or career change or even just a big birthday triggers the desire to take stock and make sure they are making the most of their position.   

Financial planning isn’t just about numbers – it’s about people, relationships, and trust and we earn that trust through a continued determination to go above and beyond for our clients. 

To find out more about how we might be able to help you please do get in touch, and follow this page for news and updates from the FPC team

BDWM is a leading independent firm of financial advisers, serving families, professionals and businesses across Leicester, the East Midlands and beyond.
Our focus is on providing a personal, bespoke financial planning service, to help you protect and grow your wealth and secure your financial future in a way that’s safe, sustainable and aligns with your aspirations and values.

Our advisers work one-to-one with you to understand your current situation and appetite for risk, before providing advice and recommendations tailored to your circumstances and objectives.

Then, through ongoing consultation, we support you throughout your financial planning journey, from setting long-term financial goals and working towards targeted growth, right through to retirement and maximising pension income.

Address and Legal Information
Bobby Dhanjal Wealth Management, 3 Merus Court, Meridian Business Park, Leicester, LE19 1RJ.

BDWM is a trading style of The Bobby Dhanjal Practice Ltd which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, FCA Number 537673. The FCA does not regulate Will writing, taxation and trust advice or some aspects of commercial lending. 

Mortgages – It’s important to remember that your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up with the repayments on your mortgage. Some forms of mortgage are not regulated by the FCA. 

Investments – The value of your investments can go down as well as up, so you could get back less than you invested.

Pensions – A pension is a long-term investment. The fund value may fluctuate and can go down. Your eventual income may depend on the size of fund when accessed, interest rates and legislation.

Protection – A protection plan will have no cash in value at any time, and will cease at the end of the term. If premiums are not maintained, then cover will lapse and you may not be covered if a claim is made. 

BDWM is registered in England No. 06943136 at the above address.

column10:
Based on the South Coast, Temple Wealth Management Ltd provides holistic financial advice for individuals and businesses.  All our Financial Advisers are independent allowing them to recommend a product best suited to your needs based on a comprehensive and fair assessment of the market. 

 We offer the following products and services:

Investments
There are various types of investment – some will be right for you and some won’t.  It all depends on how much risk you are prepared to take and what you are trying to achieve with your investments.

Retirement Planning
Saving for retirement is something that most of us put off but the reality is the sooner you start paying into a pension the higher your income in retirement is likely to be.

Insurance and Protection
We cover all types of protection to ‘Ensure you are prepared for the unexpected’.  We offer protection for your home, belongings, health and income.

Mortgages
Temple Mortgage aim to take some of the stress out of moving.  Whether you are a first time buyer or looking to add to your portfolio, we will help you every step of the way, providing recommendations from across the market.

We are committed to independent advice, constructing financial solutions, using products from the whole of the market.  Financial advice is provided exclusively by qualified and experienced practitioners.

Stuart Dawson, CEO Luxia Global

Atkins Ferrie Wealth Management was founded in January 2011 with the aim to offer the highest ethical principles and best service standards available from any Independent Adviser in the UK.
 
Impartiality
We undertake to provide completely impartial advice unique to each of our clients. We will consider all options available to each individual and ensure that every recommendation is absolutely the best solution for the client concerned. As such, Atkins Ferrie Wealth Management will never form strategic alliances with investment companies or favour any one provider. Recommendations will always be on pure merit at any given time.

Courtesy
Our aim is to ensure that all clients are dealt with the same courtesy irrespective of wealth or background.

Value for Money
It is vital to obtain the best advice available, but cost is always of importance. Our success is based on the quality of our advice and service to you the client. As such, we will always work as efficiently as possible so that our costs to you are minimised, fair and reasonable. Our aim is to provide best advice at best value.

TMP Wealth Management, Senior Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management , set in the heart of Northumberland, specialise in providing a bespoke service for each of our clients. We work closely with Individuals and Corporate Partners to offer a tailored and personal proposition built upon a wealth of expertise and the knowledge that we are with you for the long term.

With the hectic lifestyles we live today, we understand that very few people have the time or indeed the inclination to manage their financial affairs effectively.

This is hardly surprising given that the financial world we live in is complex and fast-changing.

However it is inevitable that we want our wealth to work for us and at some stage in our life most of us will need to seek financial advice, to build and preserve our wealth.

We have a wide range of expertise available through our experienced adviser team, with over 60 years in the profession. This has allowed us to help people – both individually and in business – to fulfill their aims and aspirations, as well as offering that all-important “peace of mind” for the future.

We are a Chartered and highly ethical Independent Financial Advisory firm.

All our advisers hold the esteemed Chartered Financial Planner status from the Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) and Personal Finance Society (PFS). With combined industry experience of over 75 years in the investment and pension planning sectors, our hands-on chartered advisers are well placed to guide you on your financial decisions.

Our head office is in the center of Glasgow but we have offices available for client meetings in major cities including Edinburgh, Aberdeen, London and most major cities around the country.

We have a fantastic client support team who work alongside our advisers in providing each and every client (and we truly mean 'EACH and EVERY') with an impeccable level of service and more importantly clear, honest and unbiased advice on matters relating to their finances.

We provide a service which is advice led, as opposed to product driven. We do that through ensuring all our staff have the right morals and ethos and are highly skilled and up to date with market opportunities, legislation changes and developments.

We invest all of our time, effort, resources and hard work in our clients, as they invest in us.
We take great pride and consider it an honour that our clients have been loyal to us over so many years and this is a responsibility we do not take lightly.

Your needs, aims & aspirations are important to us and crucial in designing your bespoke financial plan which, will consider your business / personal investments, family commitments and planned retirement goals. As a result, you will gain clarity out of complexity, ultimately feeling more relaxed and secure about your financial future.

If you are uncertain whether a particular investment is suitable for you, contact Just Financial Group Ltd on info@justfinancialgroup.co.uk.

column10:
Fensham Howes Limited was established with a single purpose: to help our clients achieve their life financial goals.

For every client, this starts by establishing clear and practical strategic objectives. A long term action plan is then put into place. The plan is kept current through regular monitoring, constant attention to detail, and by making sensible adjustments to changes in life circumstances or the environment.

Client financial plans are developed using detailed cash flow models and other analytical tools. Clear and focused decision-making frameworks enable clients to understand how the various pieces of their wealth fit together and how their financial position is likely to evolve over time.

Investment strategies are individually designed to support the needs of each client. Most typically, we construct investment portfolios using low cost and broadly diversified institutional-class vehicles which target dimensions of long term capital market return that have been identified by academic research. If circumstances require, we will also fine-tune individual client portfolios with specific financial instruments.

Our approach is based upon the conviction that achieving long term financial success requires planning, patience, persistence and discipline over a significant number of years. Financial research has repeatedly shown that, on average and over time, other approaches deliver statistically less reliable results. We work best with clients who share this view.

If this type of approach resonates with you and you would like to find out more, we'd be delighted to hear from you.

Independent Financial Advisors for Hampshire & Sussex

Lawrence Clarke Ltd was formed in May 1999 when Lawrence Clarke, previously of Lawrence Clarke & Partners, combined with Allan Bowden, Dennis Stuart and Ian Cann; all of whom had well established companies in the Fareham and Portsmouth area, to form the new company.

Over the past four years they have also acquired several other leading local financial Companies, including - Coffin Mew & Clover Financial services, King & Power Investments Ltd, and Roy Sansom & Company.

Both Allan Bowden & Dennis Stuart continue to provide valuable experience as Directors of Lawrence Clarke Ltd. Ian Cann has since taken well earned retirement, and is still enjoying his golf.

A Century of Service

In total this represents over 200 years of experience in serving the public's financial needs. To support the company’s financial advisers there is a team of ten backup administration staff.

Our Values

We listen first and foremost when working with you to ensure that we understand your objectives, and we fully capture all the information we need to design your financial portfolio around your requirements

We ensure that you are working with a specialist who will meet your expectations and with whom you are comfortable working with

We treat our customers fairly and are interested in creating wealth, ensuring that all your planning needs are covered and set up in a tax efficient manner

We take our business seriously, but like to have fun – not only in our friendly team environment, but also with our clients – life is for living, not for existing.

Burlington Associates is a firm of Independent Financial Planners located in the City of London.

Burlington has established a very good reputation and has forged excellent relationships with many specialist organisations to enable us to provide comprehensive solutions for our clients.

The experience in financial services of the individual partners ranges from eight to twenty five years. The company ethos is to work as a partnership and ensure that each client receives advice from the most appropriate member of the team. Each client has a dedicated contact person to ensure that their needs are met timeously.

Our reputation for quality is achieved by continuous education, excellent service standards and the use of the latest technology available

Burlington’s personal clients are almost exclusively high net worth individuals, who value our client specific service. We offer them holistic financial planning in order to create a long-term strategy, exclusively tailored to their requirements.

A primary focus for most clients is the need to plan for the transition from “earning and saving” to that of “retired and spending.” 

We recognise that many clients will not wish to retire as such, but would be far happier to be in a position to be financially independent - to have the freedom and flexibility to choose whether to retire altogether or continue to work, but perhaps in a different way that suits them.

column10:
Hall & Gertski Wealth Management is a Senior Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management giving financial advice to clients looking to grow, protect, or better manage their wealth.

We understand that few people have the time to manage their finances, however big or small, but at Hall & Costello, we live and breathe wealth management.

Our aim at the start, as it is now, is to offer a personal and bespoke service to our clients regardless of investment value – to help them plan for their best future.

Our services include:
Investment Planning
Retirement Planning
Inheritance Tax & Estate Planning
Protecting You and Your Family
Corporate Services (e.g. Directors pensions, Employee benefits)
Savings (e.g. ISAs)
Mortgages

We get to know our clients, understand their current finances and future needs and look to enhance their wealth in the best ways possible. 
You can rest assured that we have our finger on the pulse and will not only invest your money wisely but will work with you on an on-going basis to ensure that your investment continues to be the best one through evolving financial landscapes and changing personal goals.  

Most new clients are referred to us by an existing client – something we are very proud of and confirms that our personal service is welcomed by those who choose to trust us with their finances.

Our service is seamless and professional, and advice is offered from our qualified and hand-picked staff, chosen for their strong ethical values, personable nature and proven track record in the industry.

Each client is individual, so we take the time to offer a range of options which best suit their own unique needs and circumstances – no two clients are the same.

It’s a long-term relationship we have with our clients because we keep an eye on their investments over many years, steering them through both personal and economic financial changes.

Please do book a complimentary, no obligation, financial review with us.

#PWLH - Plan Well. Live Happy.

At GSI, we are more than a wealth management firm – we are your dedicated partner in achieving real financial stability with integrity at our core. Our approach is future-focused, guiding clients through a wealth-building journey that blends appropriate financial reward with unwavering ethical standards.

Specializing in a goals-based methodology, we offer holistic wealth management solutions across four key pillars: Pensions & Retirement Planning, Savings & Investments, Protection, and Estate Planning. Our advice is tailored, professional, and driven by a strong commitment to ethical practices, consistently benchmarked to ensure the highest standards are maintained.

What truly sets us apart is The GSI Way – a distinctive blend of advice, compliance, consumer duty, and management woven into the DNA of our team. We foster a culture of learning, self-improvement, and internal accountability, ensuring that all our team members uphold the values and integrity that define us.

As a firm, we are actively shaping the future through strategic acquisitions, succession planning, and a deep commitment to ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) practices. Diversity and inclusion are at the forefront of our mission – not as buzzwords, but as a vital force for positive change within our firm and the broader world.

At GSI, we’re not just focused on making stakeholders better people and entities. We’re also working to create a better world. This is the essence of who we are and what we strive for.

Let’s build a sustainable, successful future together.

Harding Financial specialises in giving whole of market financial advice on investments, pensions (pre and post retirement), protection and inheritance tax planning.

Rather than outsource our investment proposition, we believe that it is part of our service to make sure a client’s portfolio is allocated in-line with their attitude to risk throughout their investment term. 

Private Clients:

We work with clients mainly based in the South of England, offering a full wealth management service. We are committed to building strong, lifelong relationships with our clients where the highest level of quality customer service is at the heart of everything we do. 

We provide a structured ongoing service to our clients and pride ourselves on delivering this whilst developing long term relationships. 

Corporate Clients:
Through our Corporate Services division, The Harding Hub, we work with organisations across the UK to offer payroll, pensions and workplace benefits. as well as various types of risk and protection products. Our colleagues help organisations and their people stay happy, healthy and financial secure.

Professional Connections:
We work closely with local professionals such as accountants and solicitors to ensure we can offer our clients a full range of services – whether they need to write a will, help creating a trust or assistance with a tax return we can point them to a trusted connection in their area.

• Tax mitigation – income, capital gains and inheritance tax

PWS are a firm of Independent Financial Advisers that have been advising individuals and companies for over 50 years.

During that period we have maintained our traditional values ensuring your needs are central to the solutions offered.

Our aim is to try and ensure that the financial well being of you and your family is secured and that you can look forward to a prosperous future knowing that your finances are in good hands.

For over 30 years Manning and Company has been giving clients trustworthy, proven and personal financial advice.  

Based in Cornwood, near Ivybridge, we’re a respected and well-established name in Plymouth and South Devon - but we also work with clients throughout the UK.  

We provide financial guidance to individuals and businesses alike.  We’re completely independent of any financial institutions, and we offer financial products from across the whole of the market – so our clients always get fully-informed, impartial advice.


So what makes us different?

Our approach.  We firmly believe good financial advice should be available to everyone, not just wealthy clients – and all our clients receive the same level of attention and respect.

Our skills.  From a first-time mortgage to a complex investment portfolio, we have the breadth and depth of experience to help.

Our team.  We expect high standards from our team.  All our advisers are well qualified and experienced across a full range of financial services.  We’re one of the few companies in the area to have a female financial adviser on our team.  We also have a Chartered Financial Planner; and our Managing Director Paul Northmore is one of the few in Devon qualified to the internationally-recognised ISO 22222 standard. 

Our clients.  We enjoy tremendous loyalty, thanks to the personal service we provide to each client.  A client retention record like ours is hard to find.  Our numerous client testimonials say it all.

Collective Financial Planning Ltd comprises of an expanding team of experienced Financial Advisers with offices in Milton Keynes  who provide both face to face and virtual financial planning for both individual and corporate clients.
We are conscious that even for the most experienced investor financial planning can prove daunting and complex. Our aim is to offer advice that is always personally tailored to reflect the individual needs and objectives of our clients and to provide a confidential professional advisory service of the highest standard. We advise individuals, families, business owners, company directors and entrepreneurs on all aspects of financial planning, wealth protection and generation.

•	maintaining your lifestyle;
•	protecting you, the family estate & intergenerational planning;
•	business protection, profit extraction, succession planning and planning for 
         sale or exit;
•	supporting your personal, business and professional interests.

Our Advisers are fully supported by our inhouse Technical & Administrative teams and who all have the same founding ethos when it comes to outstanding client outcomes.

The company can trace its origins to 1973 when Alan Torevell founded Torevell Mahon, one of Manchester’s first financial advisory firms. The current business has been in operation since 1997, trading originally as Dewhurst Torevell and from April 2018 as Torevell & Partners. 

Our aim is to help individuals, trusts and charities achieve their financial goals and objectives. We look to achieve this through a combination of excellent client service, technical expertise and a strong investment process. 
We believe that every client is unique and our independent status means that we are able to develop and deliver bespoke financial plans to meet our clients’ needs. Trust and integrity are at the heart of what we do and we are delighted that many of our relationships extend to several generations of the same family. Technical expertise is important. The majority of our advisers are Chartered Financial Planners and we encourage all of our staff to continue to develop their technical knowledge through exams and specialist training.

Torevell & Partners manages well over £620 million of investments for our clients and we are extremely proud of our investment track record. We work hard to identify the best fund managers available for our clients. In addition to our desktop research we typically have around 50 private meetings with leading fund managers and other industry experts each year which help us gain a thorough understanding of their philosophy and their views on investment markets.

If you have any questions about pensions, ISAs, protection or more complex financial planning matters please do not hesitate to contact us. 

Torevell & Partners is a company authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 183210).

The independent way to manage your finances. Our award-winning service helps individuals, professionals and businesses manage their entire financial operations; from pensions and investments to mortgages, equity release, care fees funding, inheritance tax planning and business protection.

AV Trinity is an independent Chartered Financial Planning firm and Mortgage Brokers. We provide unbiased and unrestricted advice to our clients based on a comprehensive and fair analysis of the whole market. We act solely in the best interests of our clients at all times. We do not act on behalf of any product provider, bank or insurance company. 

Clients of Chartered firms can depend on the firm’s professionalism, expressed through a commitment to ethical practice and the provision of competent and knowledgeable advice based around your needs and requirements. Only the UK’s premier financial advice firms qualify for Chartered status.

Deep Blue Financial was first launched back in 1999 when good friends, Andrew Peters and Clive Corbett had the desire to build and run their own business. After many years of both Andrew and Clive working independently in financial services, they decided to bring their wealth of knowledge and expertise together to start a new business venture; a business that would excel in offering expert advice and customer care. 

Deep Blue Financial offers impartial financial advice to corporate and private clients across the UK. We are very proud that our business has been solely built on personal recommendations and professional introductions. We have been advising clients for many years on all aspects of Savings, Investments and Pensions and have built a significant client base.

As Independent Financial Advisers, we are subject to firm financial regulations, which require us to match your needs to the products we arrange for you. We are always happy to meet with you to discuss your needs.

We believe everyone should live their best years in retirement. 

Goodmans has been serving the South West with financial planning, investment and pensions advice for over 27 years. With offices in Plymouth, Exeter and Bristol, we’ve helped hundreds of people enjoy financial security and retire with confidence. 

For us, financial planning isn’t about fancy investments or tax loopholes – it’s about enabling you to look forward to the future and pursue your passions without financial worries.

Think of us as a financial ‘architect’. You come to us with ‘bricks’ and ‘steel’ in the form of pensions, savings and property and we work with you to understand what kind of retirement you can build. 

-	When can I retire? 
It may be sooner than you think, especially if you’ve had a long career with final salary pension benefits. 

-	Can I fund the lifestyle I want? 
We’ll work out how much you need to enjoy your ideal retirement and how you can invest to make it work.

-	Will my money last? 
We’ll help you plan what you can spend to make the most of the earlier, active retirement years without jeopardising your future security. 

-	What do I do with my pensions?
We’ll outline the pros and cons of options like flexible drawdown, annuities and transferring, so you can make an informed and confident decision.

As a Chartered Financial Planning firm, including Pension Transfer Specialists, a Chartered Accountant, Paraplanners and client service specialists, our team are highly qualified experts in the field. 

Our values underpin everything we do: 

•	Client experience is everything – it’s our mission to help clients to lead the lives they want and deserve.
•	Long-term relationships matter – many of our clients have been with us for years and years.
•	Optimistic growth mentality – we look forward to the future with confidence and enthusiasm.
•	All rowing in the same direction – staff and clients alike, we’re here to support each other in leading our best lives.

column10:
Octagon Consultancy is a firm of Chartered Financial Planners, based in Clifton, Bristol.

A little controversially for a finance business, we think money is pointless on its own. It’s the freedom it buys that matters. Freedom to design your own journey, carve your own path, reach your own goals. 

Join the Octagon Expedition - A FINANCIAL JOURNEY TOGETHER

It’s likely you’re a business owner or entrepreneur. And like us, you’ll have a passion for what you do that goes way beyond profit margins. 

Your financial journey is one of life’s most important. It makes all other destinations possible. We believe no-one should set off on such a major expedition without an experienced and enthusiastic guide. 

Ask any explorer and they’ll tell you the most important stage is planning. That’s why we take time to sit down with you and find out about your aspirations, your business, your family responsibilities... What do you want to achieve? What other journeys need to be taken into account? What are the practical reasons for making decisions? What are the emotional ones? 

We really appreciate how much time and energy it takes to build material success. Our job is to help you achieve your dreams in all aspects of your life. The Octagon eight-step approach (see www.octagonconsultancy.co.uk) allows us to create a bespoke financial route (we don’t do off the shelf), designed to free up time and ensure you get to wherever you want to be.

Invictus Wealth Consultants was founded as a Partner Practice of St. James’s Place Wealth Management to give financial advice to clients looking to help grow, protect or better manage their money.

Our aim at the start, as it is now, is to offer a personal and bespoke service to our clients regardless of investment value – to help them plan for their best future.

Our services include:
Investment Planning
Retirement Planning
Inheritance Tax & Estate Planning
Protecting You and Your Family
Corporate Services (e.g. Directors' pensions, Employee benefits)
Investment Planning

We get to know our clients, understand their current finances and future needs and look to enhance their wealth in the best ways possible. 

Most new clients are referred to us by an existing client – something we are very proud of and confirms that our personal service is welcomed by those who choose to trust us with their finances.

Our service is seamless and professional, and advice is offered by our qualified and hand-picked staff, chosen for their strong ethical values, personable nature and proven track record in the industry.

Each client is individual, so we take the time to offer a range of options which best suit their own unique needs and circumstances – no two clients are the same.

We build long-term relationships with our clients, supporting them to manage their investments over many years and steering them through both personal and economic financial changes.

If you would like to start your journey with us please book a no-obligation financial review with us.

The value of your investments can go down as well as up. You could get back less than you invested.

Invictus Wealth Consultants Ltd is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority). The title `Partner Practice' is the marketing term used to describe St. James's Place representatives.

Based in Leek, Staffordshire, Brian Mellor Financial Services is an independently owned financial planning practice. We specialise in the provision of simple, honest and impartial advice to private and corporate clients. 

The clients we work with are typically based within 20 miles of our office. They include business owners and individuals who are retired or approaching retirement and want to take control of their financial future. 

We adopt an approach that extends beyond traditional financial advice - we don’t believe in selling products. Instead we create a personalised financial plan, tailored to your circumstances and stage of life or business growth. 

Our focus is on establishing long-term, trusted relationships. We demystify investments and empower you to make decisions about your future and your finances. Over time we remain committed to identifying any factors that may alter the anticipated outcomes and provide a balanced, realistic view of your situation.

At Price Ferguson, we build lifelong relationships to support people on their financial journey from childhood to retirement.  

Based in Guildford, Surrey we have offices that overlook Guildford Golf Course, situated on Merrow Downs.

We are directly authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority.  Our dedicated team of advisors help build secure financial futures through pension planning, inheritance tax advice and family wealth.

Together, we review assets and resources, future earning capacity and how funds can be allocated in the best possible way.

Through regular reviews, we talk through the options to inform decision making, as priorities and circumstances change.  We direct money into an investment vehicle to take account of long-term saving plans, to monitor retirement funds and protect the family in the event of illness or premature death of a loved one.

-All our team are salaried - we are not paid for "selling products" 
-High levels of technical expertise throughout the team with all areas of advice covered

Established in 1982, Birchwood Investment Management are experienced independent financial advisors whose service is based on high levels of professionalism & integrity.

As independent financial advisors we provide completely tailored, impartial & independent financial advice, which will help you achieve both your financial goals.

Our approach to providing our clients with the best financial advise begins with our team of experienced & knowledgeable financial advisors understanding your needs & requirements; enabling us to work on the development of a solution to fit with what you require.

The financial solutions we offer take into account independent market-wide research & advice from our contacts; whilst the financial planning reports we prepare for clients provide proactive & innovative suggestions to help you achieve your financial goals.

•	Preparing for Retirement / Retirement Planning
•	Pension Planning
•	Inheritance Tax Planning
•	Wills & Trusts

Our sound independent advice can help everyone from the inexperienced investor through to the experienced – who can benefit from our detailed analysis – & we constantly monitor all aspects of the financial market, to ensure that we are always in a position to offer our clients the most up-to-date options.

You need a professional, independent financial adviser to plan for a secure future. Blackstone Moregate is a firm of highly experienced independent financial advisers, based in the City of London that provides individuals and companies with a professional, holistic service.

Our firm is unique because it brings together under one roof the experience and expertise of some of the UK’s most highly qualified financial and tax advisers, and we work together with other professionals too. This enables us to provide a holistic, seamless, integrated and personal service.

Most importantly, we listen and understand your needs, motivations and aspirations, then pool the relevant expertise to give you the best chance of achieving your financial and personal planning objectives. 

Who we advise

Our clients are successful individuals, from all walks of life, who have an active interest in their financial affairs and who generally understand money. However, they lack the time, knowledge and skill to manage their affairs effectively without help. Our clients’ success has driven ours. We launched in 2001 and have continued to grow ever since.

Do you like the idea of holistic financial planning? Are you looking for a personal financial advisory firm that does not just sell you products?
One who listens to your individual concerns to understand your needs? If so, please contact us.

At Heron House, we believe in a personal, bespoke approach. One that will stand the test of time. You will not find set packages or off-the-shelf solutions, just an understanding that everyone’s financial situation is different.

We take the time to understand where you are in life – and more importantly, where you want to be. Then, armed with that knowledge, we will guide you through the myriad of options; safeguarding your wealth and helping you secure future growth.

Every step of the way, you will be dealing with an experienced lead planner, plus the support of a friendly, dedicated team. We forge close, long-term relationships; it is not unusual for us to work with generations of the same family.

Another great benefit of working with Heron House is that we are both Chartered Financial Planners and Chartered Wealth Managers. So unlike most firms who focus on either financial planning or investment advice, we have the qualifications and the experience to handle everything for you in house.
Heron House has been named Best Financial Advice Firm in Wales for the tenth time in 2024 by New Model Adviser. We are proud to be independent, employee owned and B Corp certified.

Lampiers Financial Planning: Building on 80 Years of Trust

Experience, Trust, Accountability—Your Path to Lifelong Prosperity

With roots dating back over 80 years, Lampiers Financial Planning has been a trusted partner for individuals, families, and businesses. We manage assets totalling £300 million for 1,000 clients and over 50 companies in Bristol and nationwide. 

Fiercely independent, we are committed to delivering a highly personalised service. Achieving Chartered Status in 2015 reflects our dedication to the highest professionalism and ethical standards.

Our Team

Our strong team comprises seven financial planners and a dedicated support team of ten, working collaboratively to ensure your financial goals are met. We believe in partnering for success and offer a complete financial planning service tailored to your specific needs.

Our Values

Trust, transparency, and accountability form the bedrock of our approach, ensuring long-lasting relationships with our clients. We pride ourselves on a client-first ethos, placing your needs at the core of every decision.

What We Offer

Lampiers is more than a service provider—we’re your partner through every stage of your financial journey. From initial consultation to ongoing reviews, we work alongside you to develop and maintain a strategy that aligns with your goals.

Your Next Step

The next step is about you. Experience the difference that 80 years of expertise, trust, and personalised service can make. Let’s take this journey together.

BpH Wealth is a fee-based Lifestyle Wealth Management Practice providing independent financial advice, financial planning and asset management for our clients. 

The term ‘Lifestyle Wealth Management’ describes a holistic approach to managing wealth. It involves a full understanding of you, your needs, goals, key relationships and financial resources. With this, we develop a personal, bespoke, financial plan to help you protect, accumulate and eventually transfer your wealth. BpH Wealth seek to look after your personal as well as financial wellbeing, helping you create your desired balance between life, money and society.
 
BpH Wealth is proud to deliver a service to the highest technical and ethical standards. We were the first firm in the UK to become certified by the Centre for Fiduciary Excellence, an internationally recognised accreditation that demonstrates that we put our clients’ interests before our own. BpH Wealth uses a wholly evidence-based approach to investing and constantly seeks to learn from best practice around the world. This has now extended to the Global Association of Independent Advisors (GAIA), of which BpH Wealth is a founding member.

All of BpH Wealth’s advisors are Chartered Financial Planners as a minimum, a qualification held by only around a quarter of practising advisers. Many of our team members have been with us for between 10 and 30 years, providing continuity of care and service.
 
Our clients typically include:
•	professionals and business owners, 
•	clients preparing for and during retirement, 
•	widows and widowers, 
•	divorcees, 
•	trustees and power of attorneys.

Many clients require an expert objective impartial sounding board to validate, challenge or clarify their lifestyle and financial objectives. Simon Brown, a Partner and Chartered Financial Planner at BpH Wealth, became the only Certified Wealth Mentor in the UK and this service is available where required.

Crawford Dean Wealth Management Ltd is a financial advisory firm. We provide a bespoke Financial Planning service to our wide ranging clientele, who require an efficient and adaptable relationship with regard to their changing requirements.

We attach particular importance to monitoring and reviewing our recommendations as our clients' financial and personal objectives change over time.

In our experience, wealth is rarely created overnight but comes as the result of a carefully plotted journey. The relationships we build with our clients are based on mutual respect and the recognition that they have worked hard to get to their financial position. It is our responsibility to work just as hard when we manage their wealth.

We understand that there are no off-the-shelf solutions and that every single one of our clients has his or her own personal concerns, responsibilities and ambitions. The solutions that work for one might simply not work for another. 
Our relationship-based advice strategy ensures we have a thorough understanding of how we can help our clients to achieve their long-term financial goals.

The investment world is complicated and the SJP Wealth Managers keep abreast of changing trends in the marketplace, especially in the current financial climate. The St. James's Place Investment Management Approach allows us to provide expert knowledge and the most appropriate services to each of our clients.

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage. 

The value of your investment can go down as well as up. You could get back less than you invested. 

Crawford Dean Wealth Management Ltd is an appointed representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management Plc (which is authorised and regulated by Financial Conduct Authority)
The 'St. James's Place Partnership' and the titles 'Partner' and 'Partner
Practice' are marketing terms used to describe St. James's Place representatives.

Looking after your family is a priority for most people, but when it comes to finances, 
it can be complicated, and often there are options only a professional would know about. 
So trying to muddle through by doing it yourself might be putting your family’s future wealth at risk.

At Aqua Wealth Management, we’ll give you honest, open advice in plain English 
on anything to do with pensions, investments, mortgages, protection, equity release, 
inheritance tax planning and much more. 

We’ll help you save for the future, but not at the expense of making sure 
you’ve got enough to enjoy the journey!

An initial meeting is completely free, and totally without any obligation. 
Even if you think you haven’t got anything to invest, it might still be very worthwhile 
for us to review your existing arrangements, because we can usually make significant 
improvements on anything that hasn’t been updated for 2 years or more.

Call us at 01727 899 244 or via email at info@aquawm.co.uk for a clear and transparent view of your financial future.

Fortress Wealth Partnership Ltd is a private and corporate client wealth management organisation based in the heart of the City. 

At Fortress Wealth Partnership Ltd. we are committed to delivering bespoke financial solutions and services to the discerning individual or business.
Fortress was designed with the following key principles at the very heart of its foundations:

To deliver first class financial products and services to our clients.

To completely understand our clients’ personal and business ambitions, objectives and goals over the short, medium and long-term and to create a pathway to help these to fruition.

To establish and build professional and valued relationships through quality face-to-face advice over the long-term.

To thoroughly communicate and commit 100% throughout the process of helping our clients achieve their short, medium and long-term objectives.

To stay abreast of changes in products, services and legislation so that our clients receive the very latest advice concerning their financial affairs.

To achieve excellence for our clients through obtaining the very latest qualifications and industry accreditations.

Fortress Wealth Partnership Limited represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority). For more details on the Group's wealth management products and services, please visit the Group's website www.sjp.co.uk/products.

MB Capital Stockbrokers help our clients to grow their assets through our independent, respected advice. 

What makes us unique is that we tailor our service to you, the client, enabling you to get the individual strategy that best suits your needs and in-turn achieve not only the right balance between risk and reward, but also the right balance between your investments and lifestyle. 

MB Capital is an independent company founded in 2009 and created to take advantage of the opportunities that arose as a result of market reforms following the Stock Market crash of 2008. 

The founding members of MB Capital draw on their expertise to help clients find their way in an ever-changing investment environment. MB Capital provide a relationship based advisory stockbroking service to investors who want a more traditional, reliable, personal approach to investment planning. We accomplish this by building in-depth relationships with clear and transparent strategies that enable us to work with private clients, charities, trusts, pension funds and corporations. 

It is fundamental to our philosophy to be accessible and approachable to all of our clients with the same high level of service. We know the best service comes from the understanding built from a two way relationship. The importance in quality of service and fostering investor relationships is something the founders of MB Capital have made their principal aim.

A principle is a rule that has to be followed and for us that means meeting our clients financial needs with the right solutions and highest possible service.

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

The value of pension and investments can fall as well as rise. You may get back less than you invested.

The Financial Conduct Authority do not regulate Auto Enrolment & Inheritance Tax Planning.

Tacit Investment Management offers long term investment management solutions to individuals, families and their advisors. 

One word sums up our approach: focus.

It’s what has driven our industry-recognised performance and it’s why clients rely on us to deliver investment management for their family assets and recommend us regularly to their friends and colleagues.

What do Brunel Wealth do?

We typically work with entrepreneurs, business owners, senior executives and sportspeople to turn their successful businesses or careers into rich lifestyles. 

We will work with you to ensure your business and family are financially protected and help you plan for life beyond business.

We will take the time to get to really know you, encouraging and sometimes challenging you on what is important to you and those you love. Then we will work with you to target those objectives and deliver you peace of mind. Our specialists will guide you throughout your financial journey, making sure you stay on track while taking account of any changes that life has brought along the way.

Some of the common questions we get asked and are able to answer:

• How much do I need to sell my business for?/How much do I need to retire comfortably?
• How can I reduce the amount of tax I pay?
• How do I extract profit from my business?
• How much should I put into my pension?
• What happens to my business/family if I’m no longer around or can’t work?
• How can I leave more to my family?
• Can I afford to make gifts to my grandchildren/to charity?

We also work with charities to ensure that they are invested appropriately given the charities goals and that the trustees meet their investment obligations.

Services: Financial Planning, Cashflow Planning, Wealth Management & Investment Advice, Retirement Planning, Savings Advice, Tax Planning, Inheritance Tax Planning, Protection Planning.

Brunel Wealth is part of the Brunel Group. The Brunel group provide commercial insurance, personal insurance, employee benefits and financial planning.

column10:
EBCam Ltd are leading employee benefit specialists and independent financial advisers based in Cambridge. 

We work with employers to design, manage and support a comprehensive range of engaging employee benefits to aid in the attraction of new, and retention of existing employees. We also work with individuals, helping them make informed decisions and create a plan to turn their financial goals into reality. 

Our team have over 20 years’ experience in supporting employers and employees with their employee benefits packages and providing individuals with independent financial advice.


EBCam’s objective is to assist established and entrepreneurial businesses who care for and engage with their employees, deliver competitive, valuable benefits and rewards for their employees to help them and their business thrive. Using a combination of online portals and specialist professional advice, we can work with you to build the right package for you and your employees. Our experience coupled with a tailored approach allows you to offer your employees a flexible package which suits both your business needs and your budget, which can then empower your employees to make their own choices.

At EBCam, we offer impartial, jargon-free advice to you, your family and your business, to help you understand and make informed decisions about your financial future.  We are proud to be independent financial advisers, able to help you achieve your financial goals by looking at a wide range of investments and pensions, as well as offering protection solutions and ongoing reviews and advice to ensure you remain on track to meet your goals.

Mather and Murray Financial believe all customers should be able to access quality advice no matter what their circumstances. It’s unfair that many banks and building societies no longer provide an advice service to their clients, and it’s unfair that many independent firms only advise wealthy customers.

We use state of the art technology and services to provide our clients with the best possible advice, treat our customers fairly and provide the best possible service from your adviser. You can access your information and up to date policy information live via our client portal and message your adviser securely and expect a prompt response.

We provide truly holistic independent financial advice and create a lifetime financial plan to secure the best possible future for you and your family.

We believe that to be able to deliver the best solutions for our clients our business needs to be truly independent. No one size fits all and being able to offer unbiased advice from the whole of the market enables us to deliver the most appropriate solution for you and your circumstances.

All too often, we come across clients who have received advice from a restricted adviser who can only operate within a narrow product range, and unfortunately such advice lacks the quality and effectiveness which Cambourne provides with Independent Financial Advice.

Cambourne offers you a professional commitment to help you build and protect your wealth.

Understanding how to secure your financial future means to fulfil your lifestyle aspirations, and deal with the changes life throws at you unexpectedly, can be daunting.

Cambourne offers you a professional commitment to help you build your wealth. Perhaps more importantly we will help to protect this against unforeseen life or world events that could otherwise jeopardise your future plans and aspirations, helping to secure your financial future.

Selecting the right investment opportunities and navigating taxation is very complicated and dynamic; and it is unique to you.

As regulated financial advisers, we are pragmatic in our approach and we have the most up-to-date specialist knowledge and capability to help you plan and manage your financial affairs.

This is why, since 1995, we have been successful in developing many long-lasting, open and supportive relationships with clients, and their families and friends, across a range of lifestyles and life-stages by providing a common-sense approach.

Planning for a secure future whether for yourself, your family or your business is one of the most important steps you will ever take.  We advise clients of different backgrounds and ages specialising in providing high-quality personal advice on many aspects of wealth management including:
•	Investment planning designed to help grow your wealth and protect against inflation 
•	Retirement planning to give you the help you need to make the most of your retirement opportunities
•	Protection planning that helps you and your family understand the complexities of estate protection and various tax processes
•	Corporate financial planning. We assist businesses in the increasingly complex area of corporate financial planning, providing guidance on pensions, protection for directors, key employees or shareholders, tax planning and aspects of exit planning

Do you look at your finances with a sense of dread or excitement? We believe financial planning becomes truly invigorating when you know where you stand, what your goals are for the years ahead, and what your plan is to get you there. 

Whether you need help growing your wealth, pension advice, help with a mortgage or tax planning, our team can assist.

One of our biggest passions is talking in plain jargon-free English and helping people organise the different areas of their finances properly – so they are all working towards a common set of goals which are personal to you.

We don’t just want to sort out your pension, for instance. We are with you throughout your journey throughout life to make sure all aspects of your finances are set up in the best way to support you and your family so that you can spend more time on what’s important.

Here are some of the areas where we can help you:

-Savings

-Mortgages & Equity Release
-Investment Advice

-Inheritance Tax

Close collaboration with our partners is at the core of client service, helping professional advisers to focus on the financial planning needs of their clients with the support of an experienced Investment Manager at their side.
 
We understand the importance of serving you and your clients well and we pride ourselves on both the quality of advice given as well as the high level of service we deliver. 

THE POWER OF A POSITIVE PARTNERSHIP
At the Henry Spain Investment Services Market Harborough and Oakham branches we recognise the importance of the existing relationship between a Financial Adviser and their client and we look to compliment this through our discretionary managed service which allows financial advisers to benefit from our global research and expertise.
 
With access to our secure online system you can view your client portfolios at anytime and print reports that help you keep track of the progress towards your client's goals.
 
We can also provide access to a full range of tax wrappers including ISAs, Pension wrappers including SIPPs together with a range of offshore portfolio bond wrappers.
