Working in tandem with other professionals helps our clients to gain a greater sense of perspective on their unique situation and needs.

GP3 are Independent Financial Advisers providing pension, investment and estate planning advice without the jargon.

With 20+ years of experience and trusted with over £150 million of client assets, we pride ourselves on our personalised service and high levels of integrity. We help our clients to achieve their financial objectives with our holistic advice service, which also covers: personal and business protection, long-term care, inheritance tax, will writing and estate planning.

If you're wondering whether GP3 is a good fit for you, contact us today. One of our qualified Financial Advisers can provide you with a complimentary consultation, including a breakdown of the fees you're currently paying (you may be paying more than you realise!). If you decide to become a client, GP3's professional team will make sure the transition is as straightforward as possible. Once you become a client, you will have dedicated Financial who will assist you in navigating your financial decisions and act as a reliable source of long-term information and support.

From our local practice based in Oadby, we are able to provide a proactive and personalised financial planning service which places the emphasis on you and your long-term goals.

Our independent advice covers financial needs regarding:

Retirement Planning | Pensions | Investment Management | ISAs
Estate Planning | Wills | Lasting Powers of Attorney | Trusts | Protection

Our core values ensure we act with the utmost integrity and professionalism. We aim to be open, ethical and strive to put our clients’ best interests at heart, that's why many of our clients have been with us for over 20 years and continue to refer their friends and family to us.

Moneyweb are a bespoke Independent Financial Advisers operating in the Investment and Retirement market specialising in private client portfolio management. We also have strong links with business and commercial financial planning and work together alongside other professional connections. 

Controlling over £250 million of assets under advice, from our private clients, we continually work closely with a number of professional connections including accountants and solicitors sharing the opinion that in order to truly manage your expectations other professional services may have to be sought in order to provide a fully holistic approach.

Our philosophy has always been to provide a quality advice process, delivered alongside exceptional service, building business and client relationships along the way. Indeed future generations of our private clients are now becoming clients themselves and there is no higher accolade than that.

Successful planning is all about expertise and regular review. In particular, in identifying and managing change. 

Once an agreement has been made to do business, our clients commit to regular (at least annual) reviews in order to ensure financial plans are on track, and to make amendments or additions as may become necessary as circumstances evolve. 

It is important to note, any initial research we conduct and early consultations will not usually attract a charge, as we aim to demonstrate where value can be added before we come to any further agreements on how best to proceed. 

We are at the forefront of advice with an emphasis on:

- Bespoke / Tailored Investment Solutions

- Discretionary Fund Management (DFM), EIS/VCT*, Self-Invested Personal Pensions, ISAs, General Investments & Investment Bonds (Offshore & Onshore) 

- Cost Mitigation (value for money)

- Tax Mitigation - Inheritance Tax (IHT), Income Tax, Capital Gains Tax (CGT) 

- Risk Mitigation - through use of Discretionary Fund Management to manage investment risk on your behalf in a fully bespoke portfolio

- Capital Preservation - use of Trusts to mitigate Inheritance Tax, Care Cost Recovery (CCR)

*Don't invest unless you're prepared to lose all the money you invest. This is a high risk investment. You may not be able to access your money easily and are unlikely to be protected if something goes wrong.

The value of investments and any income from them can fall as well as rise and you may not get back the original amount invested.

HM Revenue and Customs practice and the law relating to taxation are complex and subject to individual circumstances and changes which cannot be foreseen.

Advanced Financial Planning is a trading name of Advanced Financial Planning Scotland Limited, which is an appointed representative of The Openwork Partnership, a trading style of Openwork Limited, which is authorised & regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

TFAS Enterprises brings together market leading digital marketing capability and independent financial advice. Headquartered in central Leeds, we provide a service to the whole of the United Kingdom helping thousands of consumers who are actively seeking advice in relation to holdings of more than £2 billion every year. 

The Group is comprised of: 
• TFAS Wealth Ltd – Our FCA regulated and Directly Authorised provider of independent financial advice, digital marketing and internal compliance oversight. 

• Inzuzo – Founded in 2015 and providing market leading, boutique client generation and consultancy services within financial services. 

• TFAS Compliance Services - Our comprehensive compliance support offering, designed to keep directly authorised financial adviser firms abreast of regulatory developments and provide clear guidance and quality solutions to help you meet the FCA's requirements. 

Our team of experts have spent years building a robust understanding of consumer behaviour, as well as how people tend to engage with digital platforms when searching for assistance with their financial planning needs. This expertise allows us to either engage internally through our experienced team of advisers, or by referring consumers to one of our suitable partner firms. 
This natural synergy of forward-thinking companies within the group is underpinned by a core belief that everyone across the UK should be able to access suitable and quality financial advice, no matter how big or small their needs are.

Leagold Miller can trace its roots back to 1890 when A Miller and Sons first started trading. A Miller and Sons joined Leagold in 1988 to become Leagold Miller and to this day we act on behalf of great grandchildren of some of the original clients of A Miller and Sons. 

Soon after our merger with A Miller and Sons, we were joined by Hartfield to further boost our experience and expertise, adopting the additional trading name of Leagold Hartfield. 

Our business has evolved naturally and we are proud to offer our clients both insurance broking and a range of financial services, including employee benefits, all under one roof. 

We thrive on challenges and pride ourselves on providing the kind of fast and effective service that has allowed us to develop long-term relationships with our clients and make a real contribution to their ongoing business success. 

In the case of a high net worth personal clients we pay the same attention to detail and our Independent status allows us to access a wide range of specialist markets 

We are independent insurance brokers, and to improve our access to Insurance markets even further we are members of Broker Network. In view of this we are able to offer you centrally-negotiated policies from the UK's leading insurers which often aren't available elsewhere even from the large National Brokers. More importantly, our independence is safe guarded, enabling us to concentrate on you, our valued client.

For jobs/careers, please send your CV, together with a covering letter to barry.m@leagold.co.uk

Our advisers have over 100 years of combined experience in helping clients navigate complex financial markets, and from the very beginning Rothesay Bennett has evolved primarily through client recommendations.
Taking advice can be a daunting process, whether you are looking to take financial advice for the first time or you’ve taken financial advice in the past. Finances often take a low priority for many people because they are complex, but at Rothesay Bennett our clients appreciate our ability to make the financial advice process both simple and enjoyable.
Based in Balsall Common (with advisers also based in Devon and Edinburgh), we provide financial advice to individuals at all stages of their financial planning cycle. Whether you are assessing your finances for the first time or you want to know more about your retirement options, Rothesay Bennett are able to help, wherever you are in the UK. We also understand that you may have limited time available, therefore we offer telephone, email, office-based and home visits at a time to suit your needs.
At Rothesay Bennett, we ask the questions, look into your future, give straightforward advice and find the right financial solutions for you.

We like to think that we are more than professional financial planners, we are relationship builders too.  We are proud of our trusted relationships that we have built over the years and now many of our clients see us as an indispensable partner when it comes to their financial planning.

Our service is built around comprehensive financial planning and sound investment principles.  By exploring your goals and objectives we can tailor a financial strategy to your needs.

Our financial planning process is broken down into a series of stages which focus on ensuring your life aspirations and the investment of your money are carefully aligned.

Having completed a detailed review of your current position and arrangements, we will provide you with specific recommendations and explain benefits and risks associated with the approach that we have suggested.

If you are happy with our recommendations we will help you complete the relevant paperwork and put your financial plan in place.

As your aspirations evolve in your life, so should your financial plan and we will be on hand to review this with you on a regular basis, should you choose.

As a result, many of our clients refer us to their friends and family so that they can receive the same trusted, expert advice from a group of advisers who combine more than 500 years of expertise and know-how.

The value of investments and any income from them can fall as well as rise and you may not get back the original amount invested.

Approved by The Openwork Partnership on 19 December 2024

column10:
Friarsgate Financial Planning are a firm of Financial Advisers based in Chester City Centre. We are completely independent, which means we can offer our clients an unlimited range of financial products to create the best solution to meet their goals.

Although based In Chester, we have a growing client base across, Cheshire, North Wales, Shropshire and Merseyside.  We also have an adviser based in London, and have corporate clients located across the UK.

We were formed in 2019 as a result of a merger between 2 local companies, Arrow Financial Services based in Chester and D&G Independent based in Mold. With both companies sharing a commitment to Independent Financial Advice and with talented young advisers in both companies, a merger brings about a clear succession-planning path, ensuring the company is well-positioned to prosper for many years ahead, providing excellent service to both new and existing clients.

We work with City based investment specialists, Square Mile, to help our clients develop the most appropriate portfolio structure to meet their individual financial goals. Their highly experienced, expert team of analysts work to identify funds to match clients investment objectives over the long term.

We are also very excited to announce we have teamed up with the Sense Network, who we have recently engaged to provide us with ongoing business and regulatory support. Sense are committed to independent financial advice

Friarsgate Financial Planning aims to excel in the provision of financial services, to understand and meet our customer’s needs and to provide a stable and rewarding environment for those who work with and for us.

We wish to add value to the lives of our clients and colleagues, and to share our successes with all involved.

We value integrity and wish to promote the highest levels of performance and compliance through honest and forthright relationships, taking account of changes in your life and also changes in the financial market place.

Lumley Baxter began life in 1969 as Robert Lumley & Associates. Founder Robert Lumley’s aim was to provide independent advice on a personal, bespoke basis and our business values remain the same today.

Robert’s son, Michael, joined in 1982 to continue the Lumley family tradition and he would go on to become one of the first advisers in the country to qualify in Advanced Financial Planning. Richard Baxter joined in 2008 and Lumley Baxter Asset Management LLP was born.


We Know What You Don’t Want

These days there are many faceless companies offering financial advice via the internet. This usually comes without any human interaction. A lot of these companies seek to bring in as many clients as possible at the expense of personal service – but we are different.

Lumley Baxter remains dedicated to providing a traditional bespoke service. This means that we meet you face to face, and take time to get to know you and your needs. We then use our expertise to find the best financial solution for you.

No matter what your needs, you can be sure that Lumley Baxter is on hand to provide the right financial help and advice.


The True Value Of Experience

Over many years experience of serving clients in and around Huddersfield and Yorkshire, we have learned a great deal and are now very much specialists in our field. As a result, our clients know they can trust us with their financial planning and they also find peace of mind in knowing that we are always here to help them. Whatever changes technology brings, nothing will ever surpass a truly personal service.


Chartered Status - What It Means For You?

We are a Chartered firm of financial planners. This means we have satisfied rigorous criteria relating to professional qualifications and ethical good practice. It means you can be confident that you are dealing with one of the UK’s leading firms that is wholly committed to providing you with the best possible advice, service and support.

Hamnett Wealth Management is a reliable and trusted Sheffield-based firm of Chartered Independent Financial Advisers who are on hand to help you make sure your finances are in good shape.

Established in 1989, the business has been built on the core values of trust, honesty and good value. These qualities have been integral to the company’s success over the last quarter of a century.

Hamnett Wealth Management has four fully qualified Independent Financial Advisers who are committed to providing a professional service to both individuals and corporate clients.

Everyone who comes to us has their own specific requirements, aims and financial objectives. We are empathetic to your needs and treat your situation with respect and sensitivity.

Some areas can be financially complex but we speak in plain English and explain everything comprehensively. We encourage you to ask as many questions as you need to until you are comfortable and able to make an informed decision as to how you wish to progress.

WELCOME TO MONENTI PARTNERS

Monenti Partners was established with a clear mission. We aim and aspire to set the benchmark for the quality of financial planning we offer our clients, and the positive outcomes we deliver for them as a result.

In this context, our mission is to take our clients from Financial Uncertainty to Financial Freedom.

OUR VALUES

Monenti Partners wants you to feel confident that you are dealing with a firm where both excellence and fair treatment are central to our culture. Underpinning our mission, we operate with a clear set of values. This not only guides our every action, but this also serves as the standard to which we hold ourselves accountable.

INTEGRITY
DILIGENCE
COMMITMENT
ENERGY
CURIOSITY

OUR PROCESS

Providing professional financial planning is an increasingly complex undertaking. Our aim is to deliver positive outcomes and Financial Freedom for our clients. The process employed by Monenti Partners is built on project management principles. Our process has four discreet stages specifically designed to provide clarity and empower informed decision making along each step of the client’s journey.

OUR CLIENTS
 
We work with intelligent, cogent adults who recognize the imperative for thoughtful financial planning in reaching their objectives and value the meaningful contribution that authoritative, professional advice can make to both this process and the delivery of positive outcomes.

TESTIMONIALS
 
‘The team at Monenti take time to understand what their clients’ financial goals and ambitions are, and have provided me with sound financial advice and support for several years, I have no hesitation in recommending Monenti.’
 
‘I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Monenti. A few years ago I was diagnosed with cancer and Alistair provided invaluable reassurance and advice concerning the financial security to put in place for my family for their future without me. First Class service and advice’

Swiftsure Wealth Management are a Financial Planning Practice based in Knutsford, Cheshire. We offer holistic advice that helps our clients plan for a better, more secure, financial future.
Based in Knutsford and established in 2016, Swiftsure Wealth Management provides advice in all areas of financial planning including: Investment planning, Pension planning, Mortgages, ‘Later life’ planning and Estate planning. 
We provide a holistic approach to wealth management, specialising in tax efficient investment planning. 
With such a broad range of services, we believe there are no standards to solutions - only the ones that matter to you. Your aims, concerns, responsibilities and lifestyle are as individual as you are.
As well as this we are experienced in helping business owners in the complex areas of corporate financial planning, providing guidance on tax-efficient profit extraction, pension planning, and protection for directors and senior employees.

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

The Partner/Partner Practice is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority). The 'St. James's Place Partnership' and the titles 'Partner' and 'Partner Practice' are marketing terms used to describe St. James's Place representatives. 
 
SJP Approved 2/11/2022

Trusted financial advisors specialising in mortgage, investment, pensions and protection advice.

Mortgages
The 'Blueprint way' is to understand your needs and then tailor our support to lead you through the complex world of lending. We'll access the whole of market, looking beyond the interest rate to guide you to the most suitable scheme for your circumstances.

Pensions
The 'Blueprint way' is to meet you and take time to review your existing pension arrangements. We will build a plan tailored to your circumstances, explaining what role your existing arrangements perform and guide you through what other pre-retirement planning is needed to achieve your goals.

Protection
The ‘Blueprint way’ is to understand your worries and build a personal portfolio of policies, utilising your existing plans where possible, to give you peace of mind.

Investments
The 'Blueprint way' is to understand what you want savings for and build a plan to help you achieve it; taking into account your objectives, timescales and any existing savings.

Quilter Financial Services Limited & Quilter Mortgage Planning Limited 22/04/2024

Alexander House Financial Planning is a national firm of Financial Advisers and Wealth Managers who can provide advice on pensions, investments, protection and mortgage products to individuals, corporates and professionals. We have local advisers all around the country or you can speak to any of our specialists on Skype. If you want an honest, friendly and knowledgeable advice firm to deal with your affairs we are the firm to speak to.

We wanted to build a business that holds true to traditional values, meaning you could trust us to give you the best financial advice and know you are safe in our care. Our ethics and expertise will enable you to enjoy a journey to financial freedom, one where you make the right choices for your future - with us guiding you along the way. We will do this with passion and determination,  so you can trust us to be your financial adviser.

We will always look at ways of using technology and innovation to make sure you get what you need when you need it, and for a price, you can afford. We will constantly look to the future so we can help you successfully negotiate yours. You will be offered the choice between a traditional face-to-face meeting or a 'virtual' Skype meeting - so you will always be able to access our specialists wherever you are. You will also be able to access all of your details on your own individual portal whenever you want to. Let us be your innovative financial adviser.

Whether you are a saver, an investor, a protector or a borrower, we have specialists who can help guide you clearly and succinctly towards making smarter choices. We will tell you what we are going to do, when we are going to do it and how much it will cost and, to prove it, we will record every interaction with you. We will always be open and honest about our advice and will always tell you the pros and cons and costs of all of our recommendations.

With over 20 years in Financial Services, we recognise that clients expect excellent personal service from their Advisers. We are committed to building long-term relationships with our clients to help them achieve their ongoing goals. We work closely to form relationships based on trust and build an in-depth understanding of your finances. It’s one of the reasons why so many of our original clients still choose us and recommend us to their family and friends. This is important to you, because a lasting relationship means we can give you the best advice and help you plan effectively for your future.

You’ll see that your interests are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we go out of our way to make things easy, like arranging convenient face-to-face meetings at your home or workplace, as well as at our offices in Truro and Exeter.

We also take the time to get to know you; to really understand your aims and objectives. This kind of personal service means we are able to provide tailored investment solutions that are right for you, and not just something ‘off the shelf’.

We believe our knowledge and experience is second to none – you can look forward to the future with optimism. 

Discover the Brooks Financial Planning difference for yourself and take the first step towards a more rewarding financial future.

Whether you’re a junior doctor, hospital doctor, GP or a consultant, MPI can help with advice on many areas of financial planning such as the NHS Pension Scheme, income protection, savings, insurance and investments. 

MPI are independent financial advisers who can prepare a professional bespoke financial plan based on your own unique circumstances, with a vast range of services offered by industry experts including: Income Protection, Life Cover and Critical Illness Cover, Term Assurance, Savings, Pensions, Investments, Mortgages, Building and Content Insurance, Locum Insurance, Inheritance Tax Planning and Professional Indemnity.

To date MPI have successfully offered independent financial advice to over 1000 medical professionals. The extensive knowledge MPI’s financial planners and advisors have of NHS remuneration and benefits packages makes it possible for MPI to tailor the perfect solution for you. MPI don’t offer these services in isolation; MPI combine them with those of a range of other professional advisors including chartered accountants who operate solely in the medical profession.

MPI was established in 2008 by a group of independent financial advisors for the purpose of specialising in medical and professional investments. MPI’s partners share over 100 years of combined experience of working in the financial services industry, some 30 years of which was spent within British Medical Association services.

Pro Sport Wealth Management was co-founded by Phillip Rose and Gareth Griffiths to provide a professional proposition for clients in the sporting domain.  We offer a transparent advisory service delivered by an organisation with both Chartered Financial Planning status and extensive sports acumen.
 
Pro Sport Wealth Management is the specialist sporting division of Group IFA who’s headquarters are based in the North of Manchester. The Group manages in excess of £800 million of clients money. Rosebridge Chester is also part of the Pro Sport Wealth family and advises non-sporting HNW clients.
 
We provide discrete financial advice to many high profile sports professionals predominantly in the football and rugby arena. We work closely with independent specialist and have built a growing network of carefully selected advisers whom we can trust to offer the appropriate advice and service. We aim to add value to every client we meet. 
 
Pro Sport Wealth Management has recently been awarded the Corporate Chartered status which reinforces our commitment to the highest standards of knowledge, behaviour and service to both staff and clients.  Being awarded this status recognises our professionalism in the financial advice sector and delivers a range of benefits to holders and clients alike.

Welcome to our LinkedIn page!  Prosperity IFA is an independent financial advice company based in East Sussex providing insurance, investments, mortgages, pensions and Inheritance Tax Planning.  Our headquarters are in Crowborough but we have advisors covering the whole of the south east.

For many years our advisers have focused on providing astute individual and corporate clients from all walks of life with an exceptional service.

Our dedicated advisers can help you make informed decisions about your financial future. We will work with you to build a tailored financial plan based on your financial goals and needs and help you put that plan into action.

Whether your enquiry is on a personal or corporate basis, the major financial decisions that you make will have significant and life-changing consequences. It is therefore essential that you seek professional independent financial advice from people you can trust.

Our advisors are registered on several independent consumer sites and several of them are classified 'Top Rated' Advisors, as seen in The Telegraph.  

Our Mission:  "To provide the highest standards of advice and service to our clients.  We wish to establish a successful partnership with our clients, our staff and product providers that respect the interests and the goals of each party."

A community and family ethos is at the centre of what we provide for our clients.

column1: Smith and Wardle Financial Consultants LLP
column10:
We specialise in creating financial plans and providing financial advice to guide you through life’s myriad twists and turns.

At Smith and Wardle, we work with four particular groups of clients.

By specialising in this way, we’re able to focus all our efforts on meeting your needs. And it means we’re able to get really good at what we do.

Whatever you come to us for, we aim to provide you with comfort, clarity and confidence in your financial affairs. Some of our clients come to us as experienced investors, others have never approached a financial adviser before; all tell us that they find us understanding, knowledgeable and approachable.

We work with:

- Those planning for the future
You may want help protecting your finances from risk, working out a plan to pay off your mortgage early, saving for the future, or securing a comfortable retirement.

- Those at retirement
There are a myriad of options now available to meet your income needs once you slow down or stop working. Whatever your questions, worries and aspirations, we’re here to help you enjoy every minute of your retirement.

- Trustees
We’ve been working in this specialist field, helping and advising both professional and non-professional trustees for many years.

- DIY investors requiring a sense check
We understand that some people like to be a bit more ‘hands-on’ with their finances. But we also know that no matter how adept you are, you may still, on occasion, want a sense check from an impartial professional.

At Verum Financial our aim is simple:

We would like to help you achieve your goals, whatever they are. Our friendly, professional team will help you understand your current financial situation  and provide a holistic strategy to get your financial plans structured in the right way for you. We then review these plans regularly to ensure that they stay on track, but remain flexible should your goals change.

Good financial planning can mean you reach these goals sooner and more efficiently by saving, reducing or deferring tax.

Our core principles are trust, honesty and integrity which is reflected in our company name – Verum meaning ‘truth’.

Globe Independent Advisers Ltd provides financial planning services for corporate entities and individuals. For corporations this includes investments, establishing and managing group pension plans and a range of corporate protection planning including key man protection and shareholder protection.   For individuals Globe’s services includes investments, retirement planning, estate planning, protection and mortgages for main residences, second homes and investment properties. Globe IFA has been operating in Twickenham since 1994 and has established professional connections with a number of local legal and accountancy firms. 

Whilst we include in our client base many senior professionals who have reached the highest levels in their fields including top media and sports personalities we are always happy to assist people at the early stages in their career, for example we continue to help many young people raise financing to purchase their first home.  Although our client base is drawn mainly from the Greater London West region we continue to serve many of our clients who are now resident overseas. This provides an international dimension to our services.

Globe can promise clients from all walks of life a more personal and attentive service than they can obtain from large financial institutions. Our experience, attention to detail and focus on service along with established efficient business procedures have produced many satisfied clients, many of whom have continued to rely on Globe for many years. 

If you have financial planning concerns, however complex or however simple, it is very likely that we can help. For an informal initial chat why not phone Dave on 020 8891 0711 or visit our website at www.globeifa.co.uk. Globe IFA Ltd is authorised and regulated by the Financial Services Authority.

S4 Financial has been supporting high-net-worth individuals to grow, manage and preserve their wealth since 2004, and celebrated its 20th anniversary in April 2024. The business was established by its co-founders, Steven Vallery and Tim McKechnie, and has since grown primarily through client recommendations.  

From day one, we knew that we wanted to embrace the rapid digitisation that has swept through the industry over the past decades. The growth of financial technology presented opportunities to streamline our processes and deliver better outcomes for clients. 

Cashflow modelling, a scientific and data-driven approach to financial planning, has therefore always been at the core of our approach. It helps our clients understand what they need to do to get to where they want to be, based on accurate data and carefully calculated assumptions about the future. 

In our decades of working with high-net-worth individuals, we have developed an in-depth understanding of the full range and complexity of their wealth management needs.  

Whether you are looking to build your wealth for a prosperous future or assessing your retirement options – or anything in between – our team of experts can design a bespoke financial plan that meets your exact needs. Our ultimate aim for our clients is to help them achieve true financial independence, giving them the freedom to explore what they really want from life, liberated from financial constraints.  

Please get in touch today to start planning a comfortable financial future for you and your loved ones.

Optimum Independent Financial Advisers Limited is an independently owned firm, established in 1995, specialising in both personal and corporate financial advice. We are vehemently committed to our independent status in order to ensure we can advise our clients without bias, prejudice, influence or pressure from any product provider or external source. We do not receive commission from any provider for any investment based product and work for our clients on a totally transparent fee basis. No fee will ever become due without prior agreement from the client and all fees will be explained with clarity as to what the client should expect for the fee that they would be paying.

Treating customers fairly is at the heart of our business and considered in every business decision we make. Our advisers are employed by the firm and do not work on commission. The core ethic of the firm is shared by all members of the team and that ethic is to treat clients in a manner that we would expect to be treated ourselves.

There is no one-size-fits-all solution for insurance in the business world. The butcher, the baker and the software engineer all have very different insurance needs, and tailoring an insurance package to suit an individual business is a demanding task.

At Roxburgh Group we’ve been involved in commercial insurance since we began business in the sixties, and over the years we’ve worked with clients in virtually every sector of industry and commerce. From heavy engineering - we’re based on Clydeside, after all - to retail, leisure, construction, the service industries and the professions, we’ve made friends and gained clients in most fields of business.

Our way of working is normally to assign an account executive with relevant experience in your sector. Then we’ll spend time getting to know your company and assessing your needs regarding buildings, vehicles, employer’s liability, professional indemnity, legal cover and other responsibilities. That way we can suggest a comprehensive and cost-effective package. We can also offer advice on risk management, giving you the opportunity to reduce exposure and save on premiums.

column10:
Financial Planning is about working together. With a seemingly ever changing financial landscape, having a trusted adviser by your side – someone who is not tied to one particular company or product – is crucial.

Using our know-how, we’ll work with you to develop a plan to help you achieve your goals and dreams but it doesn’t stop there. We want to forge long standing relationships with our clients and make sure we review your plan every step of the way to ensure we keep on track. Life changes and we know that so regularly reviewing your situation helps us to adapt your plan to your individual circumstances and needs.

We don’t work to templates or flowcharts and we understand not one size fits all. It’s about working together and discovering what works for you.

Dodd Wealthcare benefits from a close connection with respected Chartered Accountants Dodd & Co but operates fully independently. 

You don’t need to be a client of Dodd & Co to engage our services; our client base is large and varied. Accountancy and financial advice sit hand in hand and the connection ensures we offer all-encompassing advice, meaning as well as it being completely independent it also ensures it’s as tax efficient as possible too.

Operating from prominent high street offices at 235 The Broadway Wimbledon SW19, MFS is a well-known and respected independent financial advice company with a track record stretching back over 50 years. 

All MFS advisers are qualified with the Chartered Insurance Institute or Institute of Financial Services and hold the requisite Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) approved financial planning qualifications up to the highest level of a Chartered Financial Planner. All advisers receive on-going professional development and training.

The MFS adviser will carry out a detailed analysis of a prospective client's financial situation and any existing financial planning arrangements. Then after careful consideration of the client's needs, objectives, tax position and attitude to investment risk, the adviser will recommend and explain the best course(s) of action. A cash flow forecast modelling presentation can also be provided. A report will then be issued to assist clients to consider the appropriate options and decide the way forward. When clients proceed with the advice provided, the MFS team of experienced and qualified staff will implement and administer effectively and efficiently all the associated paperwork. 

MFS offers a complimentary, exploratory initial consultation when prospective clients can raise questions concerning their financial planning situation. This initial, exploratory meeting allows prospective clients to understand the financial planning options available and will help establish whether they feel comfortable that MFS is a suitable company to provide their initial and if required, ongoing financial planning guidance and support. 

The MFS team is proud of its highly professional service level providing independent financial advice to a wide diversity of clients across a broad range of financial planning.

With offices in Grantham and London and a presence in Harrogate, Lincoln, Newark, Newcastle and Retford, RetireInvest offers specialist wealth, investment, inheritance tax, mortgage, protection planning and long-term care advice to individuals and businesses across the UK. 

Our team of friendly, approachable professional financial advisers have decades of experience in a wide range of financial planning matters. Within our business, many of our advisers are working towards Chartered Associate status.

We are a strategic partner of the Quilter Financial Planning Network, part of the award-winning Quilter plc. Because our advisers work within the strict guidelines laid down by Quilter, our clients can rest assured that our advice is guaranteed by one of the country’s most reputed firms.

Every investment we make is overseen by Quilter’s Investment Oversight Committee (IOC) and Management Investment Group (MIG), ensuring all recommendations are suitable for our clients. The MIG also works closely with independent investment analysts MorningStar and Square Mile, ensuring all investment solutions are robustly vetted. 

Most importantly, you’ll never be ‘just another client’ with RetireInvest. In fact, we ensure that our clients not only have access to their own dedicated financial adviser, but also the support of an experienced client relationship team, ensuring you’re always in the loop. Your adviser will get to know you, your hopes and financial goals and aspirations, and tailor their advice closely to your individual needs.

RetireInvest Limited is an appointed representative of Quilter Financial Services Limited and Quilter Mortgage Planning Limited, who are authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. Quilter Financial Services Limited and Quilter Mortgage Planning Limited are entered on the FCA register under reference 440703 and 440718. Estate Planning, Inheritance Tax and Taxation Advice are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

At Advanced Asset Consultants, we are a leading Chartered Financial Planning practice with a passion for putting our clients first. Based in Glasgow, we serve private investors, professional intermediaries, charities, and unions across Scotland with a focus on financial education.

Our expert team is dedicated to understanding your unique needs and requirements, and providing straightforward, jargon-free advice. We believe in using innovative and practical solutions to deliver cost-effective financial plans tailored specifically to you and your business.

As an independent practice, we have the freedom to act in your best interest, without being tied to any one insurance or investment group. Our highly-qualified consultants hold excellent credentials from the Chartered Insurance Institute and have a wealth of industry experience. All of our team members are dedicated to ongoing professional development and are on track to achieving chartered status, ensuring our clients receive the highest level of technical expertise, delivered in a simple and easy-to-understand manner.

Our team of financial advisers is made up of dedicated professionals with years of experience helping clients achieve their financial goals.

Our advisors are committed to building long-term relationships with our clients and providing personalized financial advice to meet their unique needs. Contact us today to learn more about our team and how we can help you achieve your financial goals.

Sanderson Financial Ltd is based out of 9 Twigworth Court Business Centre, United Kingdom.

Lord Clarke’s advisers have more than 90 years’ experience within the financial sector.  Serving its clients since June 2011, having been formed from a network regulated firm, Lord Clarke Associates Ltd, which was founded in 2000.  

During that time the firm has provided holistic financial planning advice to a growing list of clients that now number well in excess of 1,000.  The firm does not advertise and relies on client referrals and their reputation to bring in new business.   The firm strives to build strong relationships with the clients, many of whom have subsequently become lifelong friends.

The relationship with clients is built on trust and their continuing need for our knowledge and experience of financial matters.  The advisory team have over 100 years of experiences within the financial services sector, having previously worked for insurers, banks, and investment houses.  The broad level of experience along with a wide range of expertise means that the team can help clients in almost all circumstances.

Our team of experienced IFA’s provide an unparalleled level of professionalism and independent advice on all financial matters relating to financial planning needs including pensions, life insurance, mortgages, and general financial matters.

Lord Clarke differentiates itself from other IFA’s and has specialist pension permissions and is authorized to advise by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) on Pension Transfers and opt outs.

Whilst the business operates from a single ‘Midlands’ office, the business services clients from all over the UK.

The business is incredibly involved in the local community, being the primary sponsor for Rugby St Andrew, an RFU affiliate club which runs teams for children as young as 5 up to senior rugby level.  We are also proud to support Midland Langar Seva Society, a local homeless society.

We provide advice across a wide range of services including investments, savings, pensions and protection. We are committed to putting clients at the heart of everything we do and to developing long-term relationships with our clients. This is achieved by ensuring that we understand the individual needs of each client, and to implementing tailored financial plans to address those needs.

At Simpson Kelly Associates, we pride ourselves on the friendly and approachable nature of our advisers and staff, and on playing an integral part of the local community.

We’re a team of experienced Independent Financial Advisers. We help people across the country, in particular the South East, Greater Manchester and Cheshire to make the most of their money and their lives.

Stratton Wealth Management was founded on the belief that the best client outcome is achieved by taking a collaborative approach to managing our clients’ affairs.

In utilising the combined skills and knowledge of our advisers, alongside the latest technology, we believe we can achieve better client outcomes than would be provided by a single adviser.

As an independent financial advice firm, we aren’t tied to any particular provider or product. Instead, we have the freedom to make bespoke solutions, based solely on your needs and objectives. You can therefore rest assured that we work solely for you.

Everyone has different circumstances and we design our portfolios around your goals, developing flexible strategies that will work for you both today and in the future.

The experienced team at Mountstone places a high value on being open, honest and jargon-free when working with you; meaning that you understand - in very clear terms - what the best approach is for you, based on your goals.

When it comes to portfolio management, we select investments from a wide range, including equities, bonds, hedge funds, commodities, property, cash and private equity.

Through regular meetings, reviews and updates, we stay in touch with you and review your financial circumstances - meaning that your investments remain relevant and suitable.

We monitor the markets closely and react quickly to changing 
circumstances, reflecting those changes in your portfolios.

At Platinum IFS we have been offering independent financial advice to individuals & businesses for over 20 years, giving personal service as we work to understand the financial needs of each client. We focus on building lifetime relationships with both businesses and our individual clients & their families, catering for their changing needs at every stage of their life. 

Working with individual clients and families to develop their financial planning strategy, including wealth management & pension provision.

For businesses, we provide essential advice in areas such as employee benefits, pensions, insurance, shareholder protection, income protection, life assurance & critical illness cover. 

-	Protection: advising on how to protect your family & your standard of living when the unexpected arises

-	Pensions: explaining the different options available to enable you to save sufficient money during your working life to provide an income stream for you to live comfortably after you have retired 

We can then recommend and monitor the different pension options available to you

We also advise on Work Place Pensions - where the auto-enrolment process & legislation is complex. We can help you to understand what needs to be done as an employer; and as employees, we can undertake a full and tailored review as to where you sit currently within the workplace pension’s reform regulations

-	Savings & Investments: explaining the difference between savings & investments, 
and advising on the best options to provide for your future needs & the potential risks involved; as well as protecting against unexpected causes of expenditure

-	Mortgages: complex, and one of the largest transactions of most people’s lives. We can advise & recommend on the options available (bank, building society or niche lender) and the best repayment plans, based on your financial situation and long term goals

For full details and further information please visit our website www.platinumifs.co.uk

Pebble Independent Financial Services Ltd was established in 2006 by Jason Finch. Jason Finch has 20 years experience in Financial Services and has been a fully qualified IFA for over 14 years and the company can boast over 50 years combined industry experience.

As 'whole of market' Independent Financial Advisers, we cover all aspects of your personal (as well as corporate) financial planning needs with a holistic approach, such as pension planning, protection, mortgages, investments, savings etc. We research the entire market-place before making any recommendations and we are happy to work on either a commission or fee based basis.

We offer our clients a professional, efficient and friendly service. We embrace advances in new technology to ensure we are up to date with the latest working practices and procedures and run an entirely ‘paperless’ office environment, encouraging the use of ‘e services’ and electronic trading as much as possible. We offer our clients secure access to login via our website to access their records, documentation, obtain valuations on their holdings along with many other ‘on-line’ services.

In addition to financial planning we are pleased to offer advice and recommendations on general insurances such as buildings & contents insurance.

Located in brand new offices on Shoreham beach, we are pleased to welcome clients to our offices as well as offer home visits for consultations.

Mottram Financial Services is a chartered firm of independent financial advisers.  

We provide financial advice and planning services to individuals, commercial organisation and charities.  Our aim is to deliver a professional service, tailored to your needs, based on high quality advice and access to products across the whole of market.

As a chartered firm, we seek to develop long-term relationships with our clients, giving you the reassurance that there is always an expert on hand to provide guidance.

We also believe that the value of expert financial advice goes beyond picking the right solutions.  It lies in the experience that your adviser brings to the relationship.  A trusted adviser can highlight new opportunities and provide vital reassurance that you’re taking the right steps to bring your plans to life.

All our advisers are members of the CII and undertake a structured programme of CPD activity to ensure their skills and knowledge are up-to-date. This means you can be confident that you are dealing with professionals wholly committed to providing you with the best possible advice, service and support.  

Our professional reputation and the trust of those who we deal with are vital to our continued success.  We seek to act responsibly and with the highest standards of integrity at all times.  This commitment is central to how we do business and to help guide us we subscribe to a professional code of ethics.

column10:
We believe that for too long the financial services industry has placed more value on the money it manages, than the people it manages it for. 

So, in 2007 we started Edison. The idea was simple. Build a business which focuses only on our clients’ best interests – not shareholders’ or debtors’. Then fill it with really smart people – problem solvers, not sales people. Don’t get complacent – innovate, eek out every bit of improvement, all the time. And make wealth an enabler, not a worry, for our clients.

We left well paid, steady jobs and invested our own money in our idea. Just before the credit crunch. At the time, it didn’t feel very clever. But the financial crisis caused people to question the advice they were getting, sometimes from those same institutions accused of contributing to a malfunctioning system. Since then there have been many other uncertain years. That’s the nature of the world we live in. Opportunity and crisis spread quickly. And we live longer, have time to accomplish more things. This too requires sensible planning. We need better, more thoughtful advice, given quickly and accurately, from people looking out for us. And so it is that Edison is more relevant today than it has ever been.

In 2007 we set out with a clear mission statement – to improve the lives of our clients. And we do.

Veracity Asset Transformation Service is the most established, comprehensive, end to end asset migration service in the UK.

With over a decade of experience under its belt, Veracity is well placed to capitalise on the skills & expertise it has developed and the opportunities presented under current market conditions. Operating in the highly scrutinised area of replacement business, Veracity has established a reputation of integrity, innovation and delivering tangible results.

By holding client betterment at the heart of its service, it has helped compliantly migrate hundreds of millions of pounds worth of assets onto a broad spectrum of different wrap platforms and investment solutions.

Whilst the core proposition remains the ‘Asset Transformation Service’ a number of additional business lines have been introduced to capitalise on the growing skillset of its team and wider market opportunities.

Key benefits of using Veracity include:

• Unlocking latent value in legacy products and back books
• Harnessing technology to drive efficiencies and mitigate risk
• Delivering better client outcomes
• Use of a compliant process to manage the conflicts of interest often associated with replacement business
• Profiting from a reduction in ongoing administration

In addition to working with you IN your business to transform client assets, the Veracity team can also help you work ON your business. We can offer consultancy and coaching support on all the major areas of your proposition such as investment philosphy; business strategy; client segmentation and due diligence.

For more information please contact our Leeds office on 0113 224 2800 or email info@veracity-ats.com

We look forward to speaking with you soon

Private Client Investment Managers looking after investments for people who value a truly personal service.

Independence of thought, independence of action

At Maunby size matters, we see clear advantages in being an independent, small and nimble organisation. This directly impacts on our investment process where we deliberately have a bias towards smaller capitalised stocks and smaller funds.
These investments are key to Maunby's success; our experience and ability to select good quality smaller stocks has contributed time and again to the healthy returns we achieve.  Bearing in mind, of course, that higher than average returns are accompanied by more volatility both on the downside and upside.

Discreet but well established - our client base has been growing steadily since 1982, building on the foundations established by Peter Hill-Walker.

Experienced & Professional - with a broad range of investment backgrounds our Investment Managers are dedicated to providing the very best service to our clients.

A local company with an international client-base - whilst based in Harrogate, our reputation draws clients to Maunby from all over the country and overseas.

St. James’s Place Wealth Management is a FTSE 100 company that has been awarded ‘Wealth Management Company of the Year' by the City of London Wealth Management Awards for the past 5 consecutive years and has grown rapidly to be one of the largest companies in our sector in the UK. 
St. James's Place guarantee the suitability of the advice given by members of the St. James’s Place Partnership when recommending any of the wealth management products and services available from companies in the group, more details of which are set out on the Group's website at www.sjp.co.uk/products. 

We understand that every client has different needs and aspirations so we offer personalised, face-to-face advice that covers financial, investment and tax planning designed specifically for their lifestyle goals and stage of life.

We are living through a period of uncertainty and change; with volatile markets, changes in regulation and increasing levels of taxation we are constantly reviewing and giving careful consideration as to how these factors will impact our clients and their businesses so that we can help protect and enhance their future financial lifestyle. 

We offer advice and services for individuals and business owners based on quality and strength in the following areas: building life long relationships with clients and their families, having access to the distinctive St. James's Place approach to investment management and having a diverse range of investment funds and portfolios.

The value of an investment with St. James's Place may rise as well as fall. You may get back less than you invested. 

Trusts are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

column10:
At Sherwood Solutions, a Senior Partner Practice of St. James's Place Wealth Management, we specialise in Corporate and Private Wealth Management. Sherwood Solutions was established in 2002, to manage, protect and grow our clients’ wealth throughout their lifetime and for generations to come. 

Our knowledgeable and expert advisers forge longstanding relationships with our clients based on trust and understanding to provide a truly holistic financial planning service tailored to individual needs, this in turn gives both private and corporate clients financial peace of mind. 

For the families we look after, our services encompass tax-efficient savings and investment planning, retirement planning, estate planning and intergenerational wealth management, including mortgages and protection. 

Working with business owners and executives, from SMEs to large multi-nationals, we create a financial plan covering all aspects of corporate wealth management: pensions, protection for directors, key employees and shareholders, tax reliefs and aspects of exit strategy planning. 

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage. 

The value of an investment with St. James's Place will be directly linked to the performance of the funds you select and the value can therefore go down as well as up. You may get back less than you invested. 

Sherwood Solutions is a trading name of Sherwood Corporate Solutions Limited. The Partner Practice is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management Plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority) for the purpose of advising solely on the Group's wealth management products and services, more details of which are set out on the Group's website at www.sjp.co.uk/products. The 'St. James's Place Partnership' and the titles 'Partner' and 'Partner' Practice are marketing terms used to describe St. James's Place representatives.

Founded in 2016, Lombard Wealth Associates has grown into a trusted financial advisory firm built on the principles of authenticity and integrity. Our growth is primarily driven by the strong relationships we cultivate with our clients. We believe that effective financial planning is not just about numbers; it's about understanding your values, priorities, and long-term goals. This client-centric approach sets us apart and enables us to offer personalised solutions tailored to your specific situation.


Our vision has remained consistent since our start: to help you manage your finances effectively and empower you to take control of your financial future.

We recognise that the journey toward financial stability can sometimes feel daunting, but we are here to simplify the process for you. Our commitment to providing exceptional support means that you can rely on us to navigate the complexities of your financial landscape.


Trust is the cornerstone of our relationship with clients. We understand that sharing your financial situation requires a certain level of confidence in your adviser. We take the time to listen and understand your needs, ensuring that we build a foundation of trust and transparency. You can rest assured that your financial well-being is our top priority. 


Lombard Wealth Associates Ltd is an Appointed Representative of and represents only St. James's Place Wealth Management plc (which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority).


SJP Approved - 14/01/25

As adviser fees are taken out of investment returns, the greater the fees the greater the negative impact on growth.

What can seem at first like relatively small percentages can equate to thousands in fees every single year, and an even greater compounded effect on long-term growth.

Whilst robo advice companies have entered the market to reduce fees, they only offer restricted, non-personalised advice which itself can dampen returns.

We want to offer something different – traditional, personal, in-depth wealth management but with efficiencies that mean we can offer an all-in flat fee of just £500 a year. This means investors can achieve greater returns even with the exact same funds offered elsewhere.

At Performance Wealth Management Solutions (PWM), we place you and your financial aspirations at the core of everything we do. Based in London, PWM is a boutique-sized Independent Financial Advisers office offering bespoke financial planning, mortgage advisement, and wealth management services.

Our mission is to enhance your financial well-being through personalized strategies that align with your unique goals and circumstances. Whether you are planning for retirement, seeking mortgage advice, or looking to manage and grow your wealth, PWM is here to guide you every step of the way.

Our senior advisers bring over 30 years of industry experience to the table. This depth of knowledge informs our internal investment strategies, ensuring that your financial plans are robust, tailored, and designed to maximize your financial potential.

Our Services

 - Financial Planning -
We work closely with you to develop a comprehensive financial plan that addresses your current needs and future goals. Our personalized approach ensures that every aspect of your financial life is considered.

 - Mortgage Advisement -
Navigating the mortgage landscape can be complex. Our expert advisors are here to simplify the process, providing you with tailored advice to secure the best mortgage deals available.

 - Wealth Management -
Our wealth management services are designed to grow and protect your assets. With our independent approach, we offer investment solutions that are specifically tailored to your risk profile and financial objectives.

At PWM, we are committed to delivering exceptional service founded on independence, integrity, and professionalism. We aim to build long-term relationships with our clients, providing ongoing support and advice as your financial needs evolve.

Discover how PWM can help you achieve financial freedom and peace of mind. Contact us today to start your journey towards a secure and prosperous financial future.

Southernhay Financial Planning is an Advisory company primarily covering the South of England. Our clients are a mixture of private individuals and companies who understand that by seeking our professional advice they can make the most from their money.  Our success is based on three core principles; integrity, professionalism and impartiality, coupled with a creative approach to financial planning and a belief in a bespoke client service.
  
We offer a wide range of specialist services, including advice on investment, retirement, mortgages, protection and Inheritance Tax planning, including all types of pension schemes and employee benefits. Our focus is on both capital enhancement and capital protection.

We believe in providing a high quality service, with the emphasis on building long-term relationships with our clients, and we have dedicated and skilled advisers that work together to achieve this.

We also work with other advisers and acquire other advisory practices and are always interested to hear from individuals and businesses looking at different options for their future.

column10:
At AD Wealth our objective is to deliver clear financial solutions which precisely match your needs by gaining a thorough understanding of your personal and business goals. We offer a complete financial plan or specific focussed advice and believe that financial planning is more than just money, a pension or an investment portfolio. To us it’s about understanding people, and knowing what matters most to them. Of course we appreciate that money is important, but as a means to an end rather than the end itself.

We are dedicated and talented professionals with over 40 years combined financial services experience who are passionate about providing quality advice and a regular ongoing service to match.

The Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) has awarded the prestigious 'Chartered Financial Planners' title to AD Wealth. Chartered status is an exclusive title only awarded to firms which meet rigorous criteria relating to professionalism and capability. All Chartered Financial Planners commit to the CII's Code of Ethics, reinforcing the highest standards of professional practice in their business dealings.

At AD Wealth we have adopted a management style that makes the most of our nimble size and use external resources which includes research analysts, a paraplanning team and an independent investment committee to enhance our service proposition.

Our job as financial planners is not to guarantee future returns or to try and second guess which investments will perform best - after all, we don't have a crystal ball. Our job is to use knowledge, skill and experience to maximise the chances of you achieving your aims and objectives.

The guiding principles at the heart of our ethos are:

•That we will invest your money to best meet your goals, not simply speculate on the latest trends
•We will find out what is important to you and build a plan to meet your goals
•We will employ the talents of a wide array of specialists on your behalf, so that you don't have to

Combined Financial Strategies (CFS) is one of the UK’s leading independent financial advisers, offering award-winning advice on retirement planning, investments, tax efficiency, legacy planning and more. 

The business is led by Jonothan McColgan, a chartered financial planner who has been awarded UK financial adviser of the year and many other awards. He is a sought-after commentator in national publications including the Financial Times, The Times, the Daily Telegraph and the Mail on Sunday. 

CFS provides a completely independent and personalised service. Because we’re a small team of experts, we focus on every single client and delivering a highly personalised service. Your needs are different from anyone else’s, so your advice should be too.

By taking financial advice you gain access to expert knowledge and experience. We will make sure you’re doing what you need to do to protect and build your wealth and to maintain your lifestyle into retirement.

Anything to do with your future is always a compromise – but it is vital to know that you’ve made the right compromises for you, and that your finances are under control.

We can advise on how you can build your wealth, protect your wealth, plan for worst case scenarios and maintain your lifestyle into retirement. 

We use a wide range of tools to achieve this, including investments, pensions, tax strategies and protection, but the most important thing is to understand your hopes and aspirations and focus on what you want to do in life. That always comes first.

Combined Financial Strategies Limited is an appointed representative of The Whitechurch Network Limited which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Taxation advice is not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

column10:
We offer a financial planning and wealth management service.

Financial Planning

Financial Planning is more than just your assets and how much you earn. It’s about what’s important to you and what you are hoping to do, then taking actions today to ensure you can enjoy your future.

Where we add value:

* Cut through any jargon and provide you with a clearer understanding of the choices available to you
* Save you time
* Calculate a financial target you can work towards and/or validating a target you have come up with yourself
* Providing an expert second opinion
* Keeping you on track and aligned with your real-life goals
* Removing the emotional pain or fear about making a financial decision

Wealth Management

Everything we do is tailor made to your personal circumstances. You explain your situation and we devise a tax efficient solution that invests using a level of risk that you’re comfortable with.

We do this by:

* Understanding how you feel about investing. We consider your knowledge and experience along with your attitude to risk and capacity for loss
* Spreading your investments across the worlds best companies and global bonds so that you don’t ‘hold all your eggs in one basket’

The Entrepreneur Club offers support, when and if you need it – it’s entirely up to you.

ACCESS to a network of experts who specialise in every aspect of running a business

A DIAGNOSTIC TOOL  that enables you to benchmark your business against similar businesses on a local and national level, highlighting its strengths and helping you identify areas where making some changes could add significant value.

A COMPREHENSIVE communications programme tailored to your individual needs and providing timely insights into key business matters

A BUSINESS INSIGHT REVIEW, conducted by a specialist growth advisory firm, will create a comprehensive assessment of your business, helping you define the steps required to exploit growth opportunities and reach your goals.
